//! One-time provisioning of settings, parameters, and wrapped secrets.

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::cluster::ports::{is_provisioned, mark_provisioned, provisioning_counter};
use crate::cluster::services::staff_directory::import_staff_directory_json;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct ProvisioningSettings {
    #[serde(default)]
    staff_directory_json: Option<String>,
}

async fn apply_provisioning_settings(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    settings_json: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    if settings_json.trim().is_empty() || settings_json.trim() == "{}" {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let settings: ProvisioningSettings = serde_json::from_str(settings_json)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("Provisioning-Settings: {e}")))?;
    if let Some(staff_json) = settings
        .staff_directory_json
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        import_staff_directory_json(pool, &staff_json).await?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ProvisionResult {
    pub success: bool,
    pub already_provisioned: bool,
    pub settings_json: String,
    pub seat_certificate: String,
    pub wrapped_secrets: Vec<u8>,
}

pub async fn is_local_provisioned(pool: &SqlitePool, fingerprint: &str) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    is_provisioned(pool, fingerprint).await
}

/// Apply provisioning payload. Staff/settings are applied even when the device
/// was already marked provisioned so a retry can finish login accounts.
pub async fn apply_provisioning(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    fingerprint: &str,
    seat_certificate: String,
    settings_json: String,
    wrapped_secrets: Vec<u8>,
) -> Result<ProvisionResult, AppError> {
    let already = is_provisioned(pool, fingerprint).await?;
    apply_provisioning_settings(pool, &settings_json).await?;
    if !already {
        mark_provisioned(pool, fingerprint).await?;
    }
    Ok(ProvisionResult {
        success: true,
        already_provisioned: already,
        settings_json,
        seat_certificate,
        wrapped_secrets,
    })
}

pub async fn get_provisioning_counter(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    fingerprint: &str,
) -> Result<i64, AppError> {
    provisioning_counter(pool, fingerprint).await
}

//! Replicate owner staff credentials to member devices for local login.

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::cluster::crypto::DeviceIdentity;
use crate::net::fetch_staff_directory;

const DIRECTORY_VERSION: u32 = 1;
pub const CLUSTER_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_KV: &str = "cluster.join.admin_endpoint.v1";
const CLUSTER_JOIN_LAN_AUTH_KV: &str = "cluster.join.lan_auth.v1";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct AdminEndpointKv {
    host: String,
    port: u16,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub(crate) struct JoinLanAuthKv {
    pub(crate) activation_token: String,
    pub(crate) master_pubkey: String,
    pub(crate) master_device_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub(crate) master_cert_sha256: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct StaffDirectoryEntry {
    id: String,
    name: String,
    email: String,
    password_hash: String,
    role: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    specialty: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    token_version: i64,
    #[serde(default = "default_available")]
    available: bool,
}

fn default_available() -> bool {
    true
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct StaffDirectory {
    version: u32,
    staff: Vec<StaffDirectoryEntry>,
}

/// Export login-capable staff rows for cluster member provisioning.
pub async fn export_staff_directory_json(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    let rows: Vec<(
        String,
        String,
        String,
        String,
        String,
        Option<String>,
        i64,
        i64,
    )> = sqlx::query_as(
        "SELECT id, name, email, password_hash, role, specialty,
                COALESCE(token_version, 0), COALESCE(available, 1)
         FROM staff ORDER BY email COLLATE NOCASE",
    )
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let staff = rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(
            |(id, name, email, password_hash, role, specialty, token_version, available)| {
                StaffDirectoryEntry {
                    id,
                    name,
                    email,
                    password_hash,
                    role,
                    specialty,
                    token_version,
                    available: available != 0,
                }
            },
        )
        .collect();

    let directory = StaffDirectory {
        version: DIRECTORY_VERSION,
        staff,
    };
    serde_json::to_string(&directory)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("staff directory json: {e}")))
}

/// Import staff rows from owner snapshot (update-first to respect quota triggers).
pub async fn import_staff_directory_json(pool: &SqlitePool, raw: &str) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let directory: StaffDirectory = serde_json::from_str(raw.trim())
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("Staff directory invalid: {e}")))?;
    if directory.version != DIRECTORY_VERSION {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "Staff directory version not supported.".into(),
        ));
    }

    let mut imported = 0u32;
    let mut kept_ids: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for entry in directory.staff {
        if upsert_staff_entry(pool, &entry).await? {
            imported += 1;
            kept_ids.push(entry.id.clone());
        }
    }
    if !kept_ids.is_empty() {
        let local: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT id FROM staff")
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        for id in local {
            if !kept_ids.iter().any(|k| k == &id) {
                sqlx::query("UPDATE staff SET available = 0 WHERE id = ?1")
                    .bind(&id)
                    .execute(pool)
                    .await
                    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(imported)
}

async fn upsert_staff_entry(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entry: &StaffDirectoryEntry,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let email = entry.email.trim();
    if email.is_empty() || entry.password_hash.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let role = entry.role.trim().to_uppercase();
    if role.is_empty() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let specialty = entry
        .specialty
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        .map(|s| s.trim());

    if apply_staff_entry_update(
        pool,
        &entry.id,
        entry.name.trim(),
        email,
        &entry.password_hash,
        &role,
        specialty,
        entry.token_version,
        entry.available,
    )
    .await?
    {
        return Ok(true);
    }

    if let Some(existing_id) = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, String>(
        "SELECT id FROM staff WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(?1) LIMIT 1",
    )
    .bind(email)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?
    {
        if apply_staff_entry_update(
            pool,
            &existing_id,
            entry.name.trim(),
            email,
            &entry.password_hash,
            &role,
            specialty,
            entry.token_version,
            entry.available,
        )
        .await?
        {
            return Ok(true);
        }
    }

    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role, specialty, available, token_version)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)",
    )
    .bind(&entry.id)
    .bind(entry.name.trim())
    .bind(email)
    .bind(&entry.password_hash)
    .bind(&role)
    .bind(specialty)
    .bind(if entry.available { 1 } else { 0 })
    .bind(entry.token_version)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(true)
}

async fn apply_staff_entry_update(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    id: &str,
    name: &str,
    email: &str,
    password_hash: &str,
    role: &str,
    specialty: Option<&str>,
    token_version: i64,
    available: bool,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let result = sqlx::query(
        "UPDATE staff SET
           name = ?2,
           email = ?3,
           password_hash = ?4,
           role = ?5,
           specialty = ?6,
           available = ?7,
           token_version = ?8,
           updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
         WHERE id = ?1",
    )
    .bind(id)
    .bind(name)
    .bind(email)
    .bind(password_hash)
    .bind(role)
    .bind(specialty)
    .bind(if available { 1 } else { 0 })
    .bind(token_version)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(result.rows_affected() > 0)
}

pub async fn load_join_admin_endpoint(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
) -> Result<Option<(String, u16)>, AppError> {
    let Some(raw) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, CLUSTER_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_KV).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let endpoint: AdminEndpointKv = serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("admin endpoint kv: {e}")))?;
    if endpoint.host.trim().is_empty() || endpoint.port == 0 {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    Ok(Some((endpoint.host.trim().to_string(), endpoint.port)))
}

pub async fn store_join_admin_endpoint(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    host: &str,
    port: u16,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let payload = AdminEndpointKv {
        host: host.trim().to_string(),
        port,
    };
    let raw = serde_json::to_string(&payload)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("admin endpoint json: {e}")))?;
    app_kv_repo::set(pool, CLUSTER_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_KV, &raw).await
}

pub async fn store_join_lan_auth(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    activation_token: Option<&str>,
    master_pubkey: Option<&str>,
    master_device_id: Option<&str>,
    master_cert_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let token = activation_token.unwrap_or("").trim();
    if token.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let incoming = master_cert_sha256
        .map(crate::tls_pin::normalize_sha256_pin)
        .filter(|pin| crate::tls_pin::is_sha256_pin(pin));
    let kept = if incoming.is_some() {
        incoming
    } else {
        load_join_lan_auth(pool)
            .await
            .ok()
            .flatten()
            .map(|prev| prev.master_cert_sha256)
            .filter(|pin| crate::tls_pin::is_sha256_pin(pin))
    };
    let payload = JoinLanAuthKv {
        activation_token: token.to_string(),
        master_pubkey: master_pubkey.unwrap_or("").trim().to_string(),
        master_device_id: master_device_id.unwrap_or("").trim().to_string(),
        master_cert_sha256: kept.unwrap_or_default(),
    };
    let raw = serde_json::to_string(&payload)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("join lan auth json: {e}")))?;
    app_kv_repo::set(pool, CLUSTER_JOIN_LAN_AUTH_KV, &raw).await
}

pub(crate) async fn load_join_lan_auth(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
) -> Result<Option<JoinLanAuthKv>, AppError> {
    let Some(raw) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, CLUSTER_JOIN_LAN_AUTH_KV).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let payload: JoinLanAuthKv = serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("join lan auth kv: {e}")))?;
    if payload.activation_token.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    Ok(Some(payload))
}

/// Device id baked into the activation token stored at SAS.
/// Later join attempts must not replace this when refreshing LAN auth.
pub(crate) async fn enrolled_device_fingerprint(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
) -> Result<Option<String>, AppError> {
    let Some(auth) = load_join_lan_auth(pool).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let token = auth.activation_token.trim();
    let pk = auth.master_pubkey.trim();
    if token.is_empty() || pk.is_empty() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let Ok(key) = crate::master_keys::parse_pubkey_b64(pk) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let Ok(payload) = crate::pairing::verify_activation_token(token, &key) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let id = payload.device_id.trim();
    if id.is_empty() {
        Ok(None)
    } else {
        Ok(Some(id.to_string()))
    }
}

pub(crate) async fn load_join_session_id(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    if let Some(enrolled) = enrolled_device_fingerprint(pool).await? {
        let matched: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT id FROM pairing_request
             WHERE TRIM(fingerprint) = ?1 OR TRIM(device_id) = ?1
             ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1",
        )
        .bind(&enrolled)
        .fetch_optional(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        if let Some(id) = matched.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            return Ok(id);
        }
    }
    let id: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT id FROM pairing_request
         WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(fingerprint, '')) != '' OR TRIM(device_id) != ''
         ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1",
    )
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(id.unwrap_or_default())
}

fn stored_admin_unreachable(err: &AppError) -> bool {
    let lower = err.to_string().to_ascii_lowercase();
    lower.contains("connection refused")
        || lower.contains("os error 61")
        || lower.contains("timed out")
        || lower.contains("network is unreachable")
        || lower.contains("no route to host")
}

/// Pull staff directory from the owner device saved during join.
pub async fn sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint_inner(pool, false).await
}

/// Same as [`sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint`] but fails when nothing was imported.
pub async fn sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint_required(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint_inner(pool, true).await
}

async fn sync_staff_from_stored_admin_endpoint_inner(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    require_import: bool,
) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let Some(raw) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, CLUSTER_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_KV).await? else {
        if require_import {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "No main device stored — please join the network again.".into(),
            ));
        }
        return Ok(0);
    };
    let endpoint: AdminEndpointKv = serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("admin endpoint kv: {e}")))?;
    if endpoint.host.is_empty() || endpoint.port == 0 {
        if require_import {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "Main device address invalid — please join the network again.".into(),
            ));
        }
        return Ok(0);
    }
    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create()?;
    let session_id = load_join_session_id(pool).await?;
    let directory_json =
        match fetch_staff_directory(&endpoint.host, endpoint.port, &identity, &session_id).await {
            Ok(json) => json,
            Err(e) if stored_admin_unreachable(&e) => {
                if require_import {
                    return Err(AppError::Validation(
                        "The main device is not reachable. Start it, then try again.".into(),
                    ));
                }
                tracing::debug!(
                    target: "medoc::cluster",
                    event = "STAFF_DIRECTORY_SYNC_SKIPPED",
                    error = %e
                );
                return Ok(0);
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        };
    let imported = import_staff_directory_json(pool, &directory_json).await?;
    if require_import && imported == 0 {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "No user accounts received from the main device — main device must be signed in."
                .into(),
        ));
    }
    Ok(imported)
}

/// Build provisioning settings JSON with owner staff directory (member join).
pub async fn fetch_provisioning_settings_json(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    let Some(raw) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, CLUSTER_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_KV).await? else {
        return Ok("{}".to_string());
    };
    let endpoint: AdminEndpointKv = serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("admin endpoint kv: {e}")))?;
    if endpoint.host.is_empty() || endpoint.port == 0 {
        return Ok("{}".to_string());
    }
    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create()?;
    let session_id = load_join_session_id(pool).await?;
    let staff_json =
        fetch_staff_directory(&endpoint.host, endpoint.port, &identity, &session_id).await?;
    if staff_json.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok("{}".to_string());
    }
    Ok(serde_json::json!({ "staffDirectoryJson": staff_json }).to_string())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::crypto::hash_password;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn staff_directory_roundtrip() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("drop quota");
        let hash = hash_password("password123").expect("hash");
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO staff (id, name, email, password_hash, role) VALUES ('u-rez', 'Front', 'a@practice.de', ?1, 'RECEPTION')",
        )
        .bind(&hash)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();

        let json = export_staff_directory_json(&pool).await.unwrap();
        sqlx::query("UPDATE staff SET email = 'changed@practice.de' WHERE id = 'u-rez'")
            .execute(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let n = import_staff_directory_json(&pool, &json).await.unwrap();
        assert!(n >= 1);
        let (email,): (String,) = sqlx::query_as("SELECT email FROM staff WHERE id = 'u-rez'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(email, "a@practice.de");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn two_receptionists_both_arrive() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("drop quota");
        let hash = hash_password("password123").expect("hash");
        let json = serde_json::json!({
            "version": 1,
            "staff": [
                {"id":"r1","name":"A","email":"a@p.de","passwordHash":hash,"role":"RECEPTION","tokenVersion":1,"available":true},
                {"id":"r2","name":"B","email":"b@p.de","passwordHash":hash,"role":"RECEPTION","tokenVersion":1,"available":true}
            ]
        })
        .to_string();
        let n = import_staff_directory_json(&pool, &json).await.unwrap();
        assert!(n >= 2);
        let count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE id IN ('r1','r2')")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(count, 2);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn tax_advisor_arrives() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        medoc_core::mvp_security::drop_staff_quota_db_triggers(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("drop quota");
        let hash = hash_password("password123").expect("hash");
        let json = serde_json::json!({
            "version": 1,
            "staff": [
                {"id":"t1","name":"Tax","email":"tax@p.de","passwordHash":hash,"role":"TAX_ADVISOR","tokenVersion":0,"available":true}
            ]
        })
        .to_string();
        let n = import_staff_directory_json(&pool, &json).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(n, 1);
        let role: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT role FROM staff WHERE id='t1'")
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(role, "TAX_ADVISOR");
    }
}

#[test]

    let cluster = Cluster {
        cluster_id: "c1".into(),
        max_total: 10,
        max_admin: 3,
        max_member: 7,
        usage: SeatUsage {
            admin_used: 3,
            member_used: 7,
            total_used: 10,
            max_admin: 3,
            max_member: 7,
            max_total: 10,
        },
    };
    assert!(cluster.reserve_seat(SeatRole::Member).is_err());

}

            admin_used: 3,

            max_member: 7,
            max_total: 10,

#[test]
fn pairing_state_machine_transitions() {
    use PairingStatus::*;
    assert!(Discovered.can_transition_to(JoinRequested));
    assert!(JoinRequested.can_transition_to(AwaitingSas));
    assert!(AwaitingSas.can_transition_to(SasConfirmed));
    assert!(SasConfirmed.can_transition_to(Provisioned));
    assert!(!Provisioned.can_transition_to(JoinRequested));
    assert!(AwaitingSas.can_transition_to(Aborted));
}

        .save(&sample_license(&cluster_id))
        .await

        repos
            .upsert(&sample_device(
                &cluster_id,

    assert_eq!(usage.total_used, 3);

            .await
            .is_err()
    );

#[tokio::test]
async fn repeat_coupling_replaces_the_inbox_row() {
    use super::services::create_join_request;
    use crate::pairing;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::audit_repo::init_audit_hmac_key;

    let audit_dir =
        std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("medoc-coupling-inbox-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&audit_dir).expect("audit dir");
    init_audit_hmac_key(&audit_dir).expect("audit key");

    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let first = create_join_request(
        &pool,
        "fp-coupling",
        SeatRole::Member,
        b"",
        None,
        Some("Reception"),
        Some("10.1.1.8"),
    )
    .await
    .expect("first coupling");
    let second = create_join_request(
        &pool,
        "fp-coupling",
        SeatRole::Member,
        b"",
        None,
        Some("Reception"),
        Some("10.1.1.9"),
    )
    .await
    .expect("second coupling");
    assert_ne!(first.session_id, second.session_id);

    let rows = pairing::list_all(&pool).await.expect("inbox");
    assert_eq!(
        rows.len(),
        1,
        "older coupling request must not stay in the inbox"
    );
    assert_eq!(rows[0].id, second.session_id);
    assert_eq!(rows[0].status, "PENDING");
    assert_eq!(rows[0].requester_ip, "10.1.1.9");
    assert!(rows[0].cluster_sas);

    let pending = super::services::list_pending_requests(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("pending");
    assert_eq!(pending.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pending[0].id, second.session_id);
}

    let pool = fresh_pool().await;

    super::ports::mark_provisioned(&pool, fp)
        .await

    assert!(super::ports::mark_provisioned(&pool, fp).await.is_err());
    assert!(super::ports::is_provisioned(&pool, fp)
        .await
        .expect("check"));
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// How this installation connects to practice data.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum DeploymentMode {
    /// Tauri desktop with embedded SQLite (default). Optional embedded LAN server on same machine.
    PracticeDesktop,
    /// Thin client: HTTPS to a remote `medoc-server` on the LAN.
    LanClient,
    /// Local SQLite + direct peer sync to a master device (no `medoc-server` required).
    ServerlessPeer,
}

impl DeploymentMode {
    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        match s {
            "practice_desktop" => Some(Self::PracticeDesktop),
            "lan_client" => Some(Self::LanClient),
            "serverless_peer" => Some(Self::ServerlessPeer),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::PracticeDesktop => "practice_desktop",
            Self::LanClient => "lan_client",
            Self::ServerlessPeer => "serverless_peer",
        }
    }
}

/// Role in a serverless pair/group. Master holds authoritative conflict resolution.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE")]
pub enum DeviceRole {
    Master,
    Replica,
}

impl DeviceRole {
    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        match s {
            "MASTER" => Some(Self::Master),
            "REPLICA" => Some(Self::Replica),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Master => "MASTER",
            Self::Replica => "REPLICA",
        }
    }
}

/// Persisted in `app_kv` key `sync.deployment.v1`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct SyncDeploymentConfig {
    pub schema_version: u32,
    pub mode: DeploymentMode,
    pub role: DeviceRole,
    /// When `mode = serverless_peer` and `role = REPLICA`: master peer HTTPS base (no trailing slash).
    pub master_base_url: String,
    /// Pin self-signed LAN cert of master (`sha256` hex, lowercase).
    pub master_cert_sha256: String,
    /// **Deprecated** (kept for backwards compat with v1 deployments that
    /// used the LAN login JWT). New deployments use `activation_token`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub master_access_token: String,
    /// Optional human label for this device in sync status UI.
    pub device_label: String,
    /// Ed25519-signed pairing token issued by master (`mt2.<body>.<sig>`).
    /// Replicas send this in `Authorization: Bearer …` for sync calls.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub activation_token: String,
    /// Master's Ed25519 public key (base64-no-pad). Replicas use this to
    /// verify signed peer lists and to confirm the activation token was
    /// minted by the master they paired with.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub master_pubkey: String,
    /// Master device id (the master's `sync.device_id.v1`). Useful for
    /// pull's `sinceSeq` bookkeeping.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub master_device_id: String,
    /// Outstanding pairing request id (used while waiting for accept).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pairing_request_id: String,
    /// Enable BEST-EFFORT mesh sync to other replicas (peer list signed by master).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub unstable_mesh: bool,
}

impl Default for SyncDeploymentConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: DeploymentMode::PracticeDesktop,
            role: DeviceRole::Master,
            master_base_url: String::new(),
            master_cert_sha256: String::new(),
            master_access_token: String::new(),
            device_label: String::new(),
            activation_token: String::new(),
            master_pubkey: String::new(),
            master_device_id: String::new(),
            pairing_request_id: String::new(),
            unstable_mesh: false,
        }
    }
}

pub const APP_KV_DEPLOYMENT_KEY: &str = "sync.deployment.v1";
pub const APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY: &str = "sync.device_id.v1";
/// SHA-256 of this install's LAN certificate. The main device writes it when
/// HTTPS starts; replicas copy it into `master_cert_sha256` after join.
pub const APP_KV_LAN_TLS_PIN: &str = "sync.lan_tls_pin.v1";

use std::time::Duration;

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use serde::Deserialize;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::deployment::{DeploymentMode, DeviceRole, SyncDeploymentConfig};
use crate::merge::{apply_remote_entry_phased, ConflictPolicy};
use crate::repo::{
    clear_pull_failure, enqueue_full_snapshot, ensure_local_device, list_entries_since,
    list_pending_outbox, list_pending_outbox_for_peer, load_deployment, load_row_payload_json,
    mark_outbox_delivered, mark_outbox_failed, mark_peer_delivery, record_pull_failure,
    save_deployment, set_observed_seq, status_snapshot, SyncStatusSnapshot,
};

/// Failed pull rows are retried on later cycles. After this many failures the
/// cursor moves past the row so one bad entry cannot stall every newer change.
pub const PULL_ROW_RETRY_LIMIT: i64 = 8;
const PUSH_PAGE_LIMIT: i64 = 500;
const PUSH_MAX_PAGES: usize = 10;
const PUSH_MAX_BYTES: usize = 12 * 1024 * 1024;

use super::types::{MeshSyncReport, SyncPullResult, SyncPushResult, SyncRunReport};

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct SyncPullResponseBody {
    entries: Vec<crate::repo::OutboxEntry>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct MeshPeerInfo {
    device_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    peer_base_url: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct SignedMeshPeerEntry {
    device_id: String,
    slave_label: String,
    slave_pubkey: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    peer_base_url: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct MeshPeerListResponse {
    master_device_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    peers: Vec<SignedMeshPeerEntry>,
    signature: String,
}

pub struct SyncEngine;

impl SyncEngine {
    pub async fn status(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncStatusSnapshot, AppError> {
        status_snapshot(pool).await
    }

    /// Ingest remote outbox batch (master or replica receiving peer push).
    pub async fn ingest_push(
        pool: &SqlitePool,
        from_device_id: &str,
        entries: &[crate::repo::OutboxEntry],
    ) -> Result<SyncPushResult, AppError> {
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
        let local_is_master = deployment.role == DeviceRole::Master || local_id == from_device_id;
        // Replicas pull this device's outbox only. A change that arrived from
        // another replica has to be copied onto that outbox or it never
        // leaves this device. The copied payload is the row as stored here,
        // so a stale push forwards the newer local row rather than the body
        // that was rejected.
        let relay = deployment.role == DeviceRole::Master && from_device_id != local_id;
        let mut accepted = 0u32;
        let mut last_seq = 0i64;
        for entry in entries {
            if entry.device_id != from_device_id {
                return Err(AppError::Validation("sync push device_id mismatch".into()));
            }
            if crate::merge::apply_remote_entry_defer_mark(
                pool,
                &local_id,
                local_is_master,
                false,
                ConflictPolicy::LastWriteWins,
                entry,
            )
            .await?
            {
                let payload = if relay {
                    Some(relay_payload(pool, entry).await?)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                mark_applied_with_relay(pool, &local_id, entry, payload.as_deref()).await?;
                accepted += 1;
            }
            last_seq = entry.seq;
        }
        Ok(SyncPushResult { accepted, last_seq })
    }

    /// Return entries from `device_id` newer than `since_seq` (pull API).
    pub async fn collect_pull(
        pool: &SqlitePool,
        device_id: &str,
        since_seq: i64,
    ) -> Result<Vec<crate::repo::OutboxEntry>, AppError> {
        list_entries_since(pool, device_id, since_seq).await
    }

    /// First replica pull (`since_seq = 0`) queues a full row snapshot, then
    /// returns packages from **this node's** outbox. The replica-supplied
    /// `device_id` is ignored: independently seeded replicas never know the
    /// master's local outbox id, so serving by that id returned an empty pull.
    pub async fn collect_pull_for_replica(
        pool: &SqlitePool,
        _device_id: &str,
        since_seq: i64,
    ) -> Result<Vec<crate::repo::OutboxEntry>, AppError> {
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
        if since_seq <= 0 {
            enqueue_full_snapshot(pool).await?;
        }
        Self::collect_pull(pool, &local_id, since_seq).await
    }

    /// Replica: push pending local outbox to master over HTTPS.
    pub async fn push_to_master(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncPushResult, AppError> {
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        if deployment.mode != DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "sync push requires serverless_peer mode".into(),
            ));
        }
        if deployment.role != DeviceRole::Replica {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "sync push to master requires REPLICA role".into(),
            ));
        }
        if deployment.master_base_url.is_empty() {
            return Err(AppError::Validation("master_base_url missing".into()));
        }
        let bearer_token = pick_bearer(&deployment)?;
        let local_id = align_local_id_to_activation(pool, &deployment).await?;
        let client = master_http_client(pool, &deployment).await?;
        let url = format!(
            "{}/api/v1/sync/push",
            deployment.master_base_url.trim_end_matches('/')
        );
        let mut accepted = 0u32;
        let mut last_seq = 0i64;
        for _ in 0..PUSH_MAX_PAGES {
            let pending = list_pending_outbox(pool, &local_id, PUSH_PAGE_LIMIT).await?;
            if pending.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            let mut page: Vec<crate::repo::OutboxEntry> = Vec::new();
            for entry in pending {
                let entry_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&entry).unwrap_or_default();
                if entry_bytes.len() > PUSH_MAX_BYTES {
                    tracing::error!(
                        target: "medoc::sync",
                        event = "ENTRY_TOO_LARGE",
                        id = %entry.id,
                        seq = entry.seq,
                        bytes = entry_bytes.len()
                    );
                    mark_outbox_failed(pool, &entry.id, "ENTRY_TOO_LARGE").await?;
                    continue;
                }
                let candidate: Vec<&crate::repo::OutboxEntry> =
                    page.iter().chain(std::iter::once(&entry)).collect();
                let page_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&candidate).unwrap_or_default().len();
                if !page.is_empty() && page_bytes > PUSH_MAX_BYTES {
                    break;
                }
                page.push(entry);
            }
            if page.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            put_attachment_blobs(
                &client,
                &deployment.master_base_url,
                &bearer_token,
                pool,
                &page,
            )
            .await;
            let page_last = page.last().map(|e| e.seq).unwrap_or(0);
            let body = serde_json::json!({
                "fromDeviceId": local_id,
                "entries": page,
            });
            let resp = client
                .post(&url)
                .bearer_auth(&bearer_token)
                .json(&body)
                .send()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync push http: {e}")))?;
            if !resp.status().is_success() {
                return Err(AppError::Internal(format!(
                    "sync push http status {}",
                    resp.status()
                )));
            }
            let result: SyncPushResult = resp
                .json()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync push decode: {e}")))?;
            mark_outbox_delivered(pool, &local_id, page_last).await?;
            accepted = accepted.saturating_add(result.accepted);
            last_seq = page_last;
        }
        Ok(SyncPushResult { accepted, last_seq })
    }

    /// Replica: pull master changes since last known vector.
    pub async fn pull_from_master(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncPullResult, AppError> {
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        if deployment.mode != DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer
            || deployment.role != DeviceRole::Replica
        {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "sync pull requires serverless_peer REPLICA".into(),
            ));
        }
        if deployment.master_base_url.is_empty() {
            return Err(AppError::Validation("master_base_url missing".into()));
        }
        let bearer_token = pick_bearer(&deployment)?;
        let vectors = crate::repo::all_vectors(pool).await?;
        let local_id = align_local_id_to_activation(pool, &deployment).await?;
        let master_device_id = resolve_master_device_id(pool, &deployment)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let since_seq = if master_device_id.is_empty() {
            0
        } else {
            vectors.get(&master_device_id).copied().unwrap_or(0)
        };
        let client = master_http_client(pool, &deployment).await?;
        let url = format!(
            "{}/api/v1/sync/pull",
            deployment.master_base_url.trim_end_matches('/')
        );
        let body = serde_json::json!({
            "deviceId": master_device_id,
            "sinceSeq": since_seq,
            "requesterId": local_id,
        });
        let resp = client
            .post(&url)
            .bearer_auth(&bearer_token)
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync pull http: {e}")))?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(AppError::Internal(format!(
                "sync pull http status {}",
                resp.status()
            )));
        }
        let pulled: SyncPullResponseBody = resp
            .json()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync pull decode: {e}")))?;
        if since_seq <= 0 {
            // Independent year seeds use the same `seed-yr-apt-*` ids with
            // different rows. LWW then keeps the replica's calendar. Drop
            // local seed appointments so the master's snapshot is the source.
            let _ = sqlx::query("DELETE FROM appointment WHERE id LIKE 'seed-yr-apt-%'")
                .execute(pool)
                .await;
        }
        let mut applied = 0u32;
        let mut skipped = 0u32;
        // Cursor stops at the last row before the first failure still under
        // the retry limit. Later rows in this batch are still applied, so a
        // parent that sorts after a child can land and the child succeeds
        // on the next pull. Rows after the hole are fetched again; apply is
        // idempotent.
        let mut cursor: Option<(String, i64)> = None;
        let mut blocked = false;
        for entry in &pulled.entries {
            match apply_remote_entry_phased(
                pool,
                &local_id,
                false,
                true,
                ConflictPolicy::LastWriteWins,
                entry,
            )
            .await
            {
                Ok(did_apply) => {
                    if did_apply {
                        applied += 1;
                    } else {
                        skipped += 1;
                    }
                    clear_pull_failure(pool, &entry.device_id, entry.seq).await?;
                    if !blocked {
                        cursor = Some((entry.device_id.clone(), entry.seq));
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    let attempts = record_pull_failure(pool, &entry.device_id, entry.seq).await?;
                    tracing::warn!(
                        target: "medoc::sync",
                        event = "REPLICA_PULL_ROW_SKIP",
                        table = %entry.entity_table,
                        id = %entry.entity_id,
                        attempts,
                        error = %e
                    );
                    skipped += 1;
                    if attempts >= PULL_ROW_RETRY_LIMIT {
                        tracing::warn!(
                            target: "medoc::sync",
                            event = "REPLICA_PULL_ROW_GAVE_UP",
                            table = %entry.entity_table,
                            id = %entry.entity_id,
                            seq = entry.seq,
                            attempts
                        );
                        clear_pull_failure(pool, &entry.device_id, entry.seq).await?;
                        if !blocked {
                            cursor = Some((entry.device_id.clone(), entry.seq));
                        }
                    } else {
                        blocked = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some((device_id, seq)) = cursor {
            set_observed_seq(pool, &device_id, seq).await?;
        }
        fetch_attachment_blobs(
            &client,
            &deployment.master_base_url,
            &bearer_token,
            pool,
            &pulled.entries,
        )
        .await;
        Ok(SyncPullResult { applied, skipped })
    }

    /// Per-peer delivery is tracked in `sync_peer_vector` so repeated mesh
    /// cycles do not re-push the same seq to the same peer.
    pub async fn run_mesh_sync(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<MeshSyncReport, AppError> {
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        if !deployment.unstable_mesh {
            return Ok(MeshSyncReport {
                attempted: 0,
                succeeded: 0,
                errors: vec!["unstable_mesh flag is OFF".into()],
            });
        }
        if deployment.mode != DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer
            || deployment.role != DeviceRole::Replica
        {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "mesh sync requires serverless_peer REPLICA".into(),
            ));
        }
        let bearer_token = pick_bearer(&deployment)?;
        let peers = fetch_peer_list(pool, &deployment, &bearer_token).await?;
        let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
        let mut report = MeshSyncReport::default();
        if peers.is_empty() {
            return Ok(report);
        }
        for peer in peers {
            if peer.device_id == local_id {
                continue;
            }
            report.attempted += 1;
            let Some(base) = peer.peer_base_url.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) else {
                report.errors.push(format!(
                    "peer {} skipped: no peer_base_url advertised",
                    peer.device_id
                ));
                continue;
            };
            let pending = list_pending_outbox_for_peer(pool, &local_id, &peer.device_id).await?;
            if pending.is_empty() {
                report.succeeded += 1;
                continue;
            }
            match push_to_peer(
                pool,
                base,
                &bearer_token,
                &local_id,
                &peer.device_id,
                &pending,
            )
            .await
            {
                Ok(_) => report.succeeded += 1,
                Err(e) => report.errors.push(format!("peer {}: {e}", peer.device_id)),
            }
        }
        Ok(report)
    }

    /// Bidirectional sync for serverless replica.
    ///
    /// Product order (C8): **push** member changes (LWW merge on master), then
    /// **pull** admin authoritative rows onto the replica (`admin_pull` phase).
    pub async fn run_replica_sync(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncRunReport, AppError> {
        let mut report = SyncRunReport {
            push: None,
            pull: None,
            mesh: None,
            error: None,
        };
        match Self::push_to_master(pool).await {
            Ok(push) => report.push = Some(push),
            Err(e) => report.error = Some(format!("push: {e}")),
        }
        match Self::pull_from_master(pool).await {
            Ok(pull) => report.pull = Some(pull),
            Err(e) => {
                let msg = format!("pull: {e}");
                report.error = Some(match report.error {
                    Some(prev) => format!("{prev}; {msg}"),
                    None => msg,
                });
            }
        }
        let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
        if deployment.unstable_mesh {
            match Self::run_mesh_sync(pool).await {
                Ok(mesh) => {
                    if !mesh.errors.is_empty() {
                        let msg = format!("mesh: {}", mesh.errors.join("; "));
                        report.error = Some(match report.error {
                            Some(prev) => format!("{prev}; {msg}"),
                            None => msg,
                        });
                    }
                    report.mesh = Some(mesh);
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    let msg = format!("mesh: {e}");
                    report.error = Some(match report.error {
                        Some(prev) => format!("{prev}; {msg}"),
                        None => msg,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        let pulled = report
            .pull
            .as_ref()
            .map(|p| p.applied.saturating_add(p.skipped))
            .unwrap_or(0);
        if let Err(e) = crate::reconcile::maybe_hourly(pool, pulled, report.error.as_deref()).await
        {
            tracing::warn!(
                target: "medoc::sync",
                event = "RECONCILE_HOURLY_FAILED",
                error = %e
            );
        }
        Ok(report)
    }

    /// Repeat push/pull until a pull returns fewer than one outbox page (initial catch-up).
    pub async fn run_replica_sync_until_caught_up(
        pool: &SqlitePool,
    ) -> Result<SyncRunReport, AppError> {
        let mut last = SyncRunReport {
            push: None,
            pull: None,
            mesh: None,
            error: None,
        };
        for _ in 0..256 {
            last = Self::run_replica_sync(pool).await?;
            let pulled = last
                .pull
                .as_ref()
                .map(|p| p.applied.saturating_add(p.skipped))
                .unwrap_or(0);
            if pulled < 500 {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(last)
    }

    pub async fn set_deployment(
        pool: &SqlitePool,
        cfg: crate::deployment::SyncDeploymentConfig,
    ) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        save_deployment(pool, &cfg).await?;
        let local_id = align_local_id_to_activation(pool, &cfg).await?;
        let display = if cfg.device_label.is_empty() {
            "This device"
        } else {
            cfg.device_label.as_str()
        };
        let (peer_url, peer_cert) = if cfg.role == DeviceRole::Replica {
            (
                (!cfg.master_base_url.is_empty()).then_some(cfg.master_base_url.as_str()),
                (!cfg.master_cert_sha256.is_empty()).then_some(cfg.master_cert_sha256.as_str()),
            )
        } else {
            (None, None)
        };
        crate::repo::register_local_device(pool, &local_id, display, cfg.role, peer_url, peer_cert)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

async fn find_master_device_id(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    let id: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT device_id FROM sync_device WHERE role = 'MASTER' AND is_local = 0 LIMIT 1",
    )
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if let Some(id) = id {
        return Ok(id);
    }
    let local: String = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT device_id FROM sync_device WHERE role = 'MASTER' AND is_local = 1 LIMIT 1",
    )
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?
    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::Validation("no master device registered".into()))?;
    Ok(local)
}

/// Prefer the deployment's `master_device_id` (set during pairing). Falls
/// back to the sync_device registry when the id is missing.
async fn resolve_master_device_id(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    if !deployment.master_device_id.is_empty() {
        return Ok(deployment.master_device_id.clone());
    }
    find_master_device_id(pool).await
}

/// Choose the Authorization bearer for replica → master calls. Prefers the
/// new activation token (Ed25519-signed by master); falls back to the
/// legacy JWT for installs paired before Slice 4.
/// `fromDeviceId` has to be the device id baked into the activation token.
/// Join can leave `sync.device_id.v1` as a later fingerprint while the token
/// still names the paired one; the master answers that push with 403.
async fn align_local_id_to_activation(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
    let Some(authorized) = verified_activation_device_id(deployment) else {
        return Ok(local_id);
    };
    if authorized == local_id {
        return Ok(local_id);
    }
    if !activation_names_this_install(pool, &authorized).await? {
        tracing::warn!(
            target: "medoc::sync",
            event = "SYNC_DEVICE_ID_TOKEN_NOT_THIS_INSTALL",
            local_id = %local_id,
            token_device_id = %authorized
        );
        return Ok(local_id);
    }
    tracing::warn!(
        target: "medoc::sync",
        event = "SYNC_DEVICE_ID_ALIGNED_TO_TOKEN",
        from = %local_id,
        to = %authorized
    );
    crate::repo::adopt_local_device_id(
        pool,
        &local_id,
        &authorized,
        &deployment.device_label,
        deployment.role,
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(authorized)
}

/// The activation token names this install when its device id is the loaded
/// cluster key, or the fingerprint this device presented when it joined.
/// A verified token alone is not enough: that would let a copied token rename
/// this install to someone else's device.
async fn activation_names_this_install(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    authorized: &str,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let fingerprint = crate::cluster::crypto::DeviceIdentity::try_load()
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .map(|identity| identity.fingerprint);
    if fingerprint.as_deref() == Some(authorized) {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    let joined: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairing_request
         WHERE TRIM(fingerprint) = ?1 OR TRIM(device_id) = ?1",
    )
    .bind(authorized)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(joined > 0)
}

fn verified_activation_device_id(deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig) -> Option<String> {
    let token = deployment.activation_token.trim();
    let pk = deployment.master_pubkey.trim();
    if token.is_empty() || pk.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let key = crate::master_keys::parse_pubkey_b64(pk).ok()?;
    let payload = crate::pairing::verify_activation_token(token, &key).ok()?;
    let id = payload.device_id.trim();
    if id.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(id.to_string())
    }
}

fn pick_bearer(deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    if !deployment.activation_token.is_empty() {
        return Ok(deployment.activation_token.clone());
    }
    if !deployment.master_access_token.is_empty() {
        return Ok(deployment.master_access_token.clone());
    }
    Err(AppError::Validation(
        "Replica not paired — complete the pairing flow".into(),
    ))
}

async fn relay_payload(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entry: &crate::repo::OutboxEntry,
) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    if entry.op == "DELETE" {
        return Ok(entry.payload_json.clone());
    }
    match load_row_payload_json(pool, &entry.entity_table, &entry.entity_id).await? {
        Some(json) => Ok(json),
        None => Ok(entry.payload_json.clone()),
    }
}

const MISSING_BLOBS_KV: &str = "sync.missing_blobs.v1";

fn payload_sha256(payload_json: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(payload_json).ok()?;
    value
        .get("sha256")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .map(|s| s.to_ascii_lowercase())
}

async fn load_missing_blobs(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Vec<String> {
    let raw = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(pool, MISSING_BLOBS_KV)
        .await
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "[]".into());
    serde_json::from_str(&raw).unwrap_or_default()
}

async fn store_missing_blobs(pool: &SqlitePool, shas: &[String]) {
    let _ = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::set(
        pool,
        MISSING_BLOBS_KV,
        &serde_json::to_string(shas).unwrap_or_else(|_| "[]".into()),
    )
    .await;
}

async fn remember_missing_blob(pool: &SqlitePool, sha: &str) {
    let mut list = load_missing_blobs(pool).await;
    if !list.iter().any(|s| s == sha) {
        list.push(sha.to_string());
        store_missing_blobs(pool, &list).await;
    }
}

async fn forget_missing_blob(pool: &SqlitePool, sha: &str) {
    let list = load_missing_blobs(pool).await;
    let next: Vec<String> = list.into_iter().filter(|s| s != sha).collect();
    store_missing_blobs(pool, &next).await;
}

fn blob_url(base: &str, sha: &str) -> String {
    format!("{}/api/v1/sync/blob/{sha}", base.trim_end_matches('/'))
}

async fn put_attachment_blobs(
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    base: &str,
    token: &str,
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    page: &[crate::repo::OutboxEntry],
) {
    for entry in page {
        if entry.entity_table != "chart_attachment" || entry.op == "DELETE" {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(sha) = payload_sha256(&entry.payload_json) else {
            continue;
        };
        let bytes =
            match medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_blob::get_bytes(pool, &sha).await {
                Ok(b) if !b.is_empty() => b,
                _ => {
                    remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await;
                    continue;
                }
            };
        match client
            .put(blob_url(base, &sha))
            .bearer_auth(token)
            .body(bytes)
            .send()
            .await
        {
            Ok(resp) if resp.status().is_success() => forget_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await,
            _ => remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await,
        }
    }
}

async fn fetch_attachment_blobs(
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    base: &str,
    token: &str,
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entries: &[crate::repo::OutboxEntry],
) {
    let mut shas: Vec<String> = entries
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.entity_table == "chart_attachment" && e.op != "DELETE")
        .filter_map(|e| payload_sha256(&e.payload_json))
        .collect();
    shas.extend(load_missing_blobs(pool).await);
    shas.sort();
    shas.dedup();
    for sha in shas {
        if medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_blob::get_bytes(pool, &sha)
            .await
            .is_ok()
        {
            forget_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await;
            continue;
        }
        let resp = match client
            .get(blob_url(base, &sha))
            .bearer_auth(token)
            .send()
            .await
        {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(_) => {
                remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await;
                continue;
            }
        };
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await;
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(bytes) = resp.bytes().await else {
            remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await;
            continue;
        };
        match medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_blob::put_verified(pool, &sha, &bytes)
            .await
        {
            Ok(()) => forget_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await,
            Err(_) => remember_missing_blob(pool, &sha).await,
        }
    }
}

fn build_http_client(cert_sha256: &str) -> Result<reqwest::Client, AppError> {
    crate::tls_pin::pinned_http_client(cert_sha256, Duration::from_secs(60))
}

/// Deployment pin, or the fingerprint already stored on the device row.
pub(crate) async fn master_http_client_for_reconcile(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, AppError> {
    master_http_client(pool, deployment).await
}

async fn master_http_client(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, AppError> {
    let pin = if crate::tls_pin::is_sha256_pin(&deployment.master_cert_sha256) {
        crate::tls_pin::normalize_sha256_pin(&deployment.master_cert_sha256)
    } else {
        let stored: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Option<String>>(
            "SELECT peer_cert_sha256 FROM sync_device
             WHERE peer_cert_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(peer_cert_sha256)) > 0
             ORDER BY is_local DESC
             LIMIT 1",
        )
        .fetch_optional(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?
        .flatten()
        .filter(|value| crate::tls_pin::is_sha256_pin(value))
        .map(|value| crate::tls_pin::normalize_sha256_pin(&value));
        let Some(pin) = stored else {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(
                "sync TLS pin missing — refusing to accept an unpinned certificate".into(),
            ));
        };
        let mut cfg = deployment.clone();
        cfg.master_cert_sha256 = pin.clone();
        save_deployment(pool, &cfg).await?;
        pin
    };
    build_http_client(&pin)
}

/// Fetches the signed peer list from the master and verifies the Ed25519
/// signature against the pinned `master_pubkey` from pairing.
async fn fetch_peer_list(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    deployment: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
    bearer_token: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<MeshPeerInfo>, AppError> {
    if deployment.master_base_url.is_empty() {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "master_base_url missing for mesh sync".into(),
        ));
    }
    if deployment.master_pubkey.is_empty() {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "master_pubkey missing for mesh peer-list verification".into(),
        ));
    }
    let url = format!(
        "{}/api/v1/pairing/peers",
        deployment.master_base_url.trim_end_matches('/')
    );
    let client = master_http_client(pool, deployment).await?;
    let resp = client
        .get(&url)
        .bearer_auth(bearer_token)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("peers http: {e}")))?;
    if !resp.status().is_success() {
        return Err(AppError::Internal(format!(
            "peers http status {}",
            resp.status()
        )));
    }
    let body: MeshPeerListResponse = resp
        .json()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("peers decode: {e}")))?;
    let canonical = serde_json::json!({
        "masterDeviceId": body.master_device_id,
        "peers": body.peers,
    });
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&canonical)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("peers canonical json: {e}")))?;
    let pubkey = crate::master_keys::parse_pubkey_b64(&deployment.master_pubkey)?;
    crate::master_keys::verify(&pubkey, &bytes, &body.signature)?;
    Ok(body
        .peers
        .into_iter()
        .map(|p| MeshPeerInfo {
            device_id: p.device_id,
            peer_base_url: p.peer_base_url,
        })
        .collect())
}

async fn push_to_peer(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    peer_base_url: &str,
    bearer_token: &str,
    local_id: &str,
    target_device_id: &str,
    pending: &[crate::repo::OutboxEntry],
) -> Result<SyncPushResult, AppError> {
    if pending.is_empty() {
        return Ok(SyncPushResult {
            accepted: 0,
            last_seq: 0,
        });
    }
    let last_seq = pending.last().map(|e| e.seq).unwrap_or(0);
    let stored_pin: Option<Option<String>> =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT peer_cert_sha256 FROM sync_device WHERE device_id = ?1")
            .bind(target_device_id)
            .fetch_optional(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let Some(pin) = stored_pin
        .flatten()
        .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
    else {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(format!(
            "peer {target_device_id} has no TLS pin"
        )));
    };
    let client = build_http_client(&pin)?;
    put_attachment_blobs(&client, peer_base_url, bearer_token, pool, pending).await;
    let url = format!("{}/api/v1/sync/push", peer_base_url.trim_end_matches('/'));
    let body = serde_json::json!({
        "fromDeviceId": local_id,
        "entries": pending,
    });
    let resp = client
        .post(&url)
        .bearer_auth(bearer_token)
        .json(&body)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("peer push http: {e}")))?;
    if !resp.status().is_success() {
        return Err(AppError::Internal(format!(
            "peer push http status {}",
            resp.status()
        )));
    }
    let result: SyncPushResult = resp
        .json()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("peer push decode: {e}")))?;
    mark_peer_delivery(pool, local_id, target_device_id, last_seq).await?;
    Ok(result)
}

/// Relay outbox row and `sync_applied` commit together. A failed relay leaves
/// the source sequence unmarked so the next push retries both.
async fn mark_applied_with_relay(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    local_id: &str,
    entry: &crate::repo::OutboxEntry,
    relay_payload: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let mut tx = pool.begin().await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if let Some(payload) = relay_payload {
        let seq: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "INSERT INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, 1)
             ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1
             RETURNING seq",
        )
        .bind(local_id)
        .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let created_at = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO sync_outbox (id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at)
             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)",
        )
        .bind(&id)
        .bind(local_id)
        .bind(seq)
        .bind(&entry.entity_table)
        .bind(&entry.entity_id)
        .bind(&entry.op)
        .bind(payload)
        .bind(&created_at)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    }
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_applied (source_device_id, source_seq) VALUES (?1, ?2)",
    )
    .bind(&entry.device_id)
    .bind(entry.seq)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    tx.commit().await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::repo::save_deployment;
    use crate::schema::ensure_sync_tables;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};

    /// Slice 6 regression — replica's locally-newer row must not be clobbered
    /// when the master pushes an older `updated_at`.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn master_does_not_overwrite_newer_replica_row() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.expect("schema");

        // Seed a local patient row that already has a *newer* updated_at than
        // the incoming master push.
        let id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000aa";
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number,
                                  phone, email, address, status, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?1, 'Local Newer', '1990-01-01', 'MALE', 'V-A',
                     NULL, NULL, NULL, 'ACTIVE', '2099-01-01 00:00:00', '2099-01-02 00:00:00')",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("seed");

        // Outbox entry from a remote (master) device with an *older* updated_at.
        let master_device = "master-device-id";
        let entry = crate::repo::OutboxEntry {
            id: "e1".into(),
            device_id: master_device.into(),
            seq: 1,
            entity_table: "patient".into(),
            entity_id: id.into(),
            op: "UPDATE".into(),
            payload_json: format!(
                r#"{{"id":"{id}","name":"Master Older","updated_at":"2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}"#
            ),
            created_at: "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
        };

        // Local is REPLICA. The freshness policy should keep the local "Local Newer" row.
        let res = SyncEngine::ingest_push(&pool, master_device, std::slice::from_ref(&entry))
            .await
            .expect("ingest");
        assert_eq!(res.accepted, 1, "applied flag should still be marked");

        let name: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT name FROM patient WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(id)
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("read back");
        assert_eq!(name, "Local Newer", "newer local row must be preserved");
    }

    /// Slice 6 — older local row must be overwritten by a newer master push.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn newer_master_push_overwrites_older_replica_row() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.expect("schema");

        let id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000bb";
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number,
                                  phone, email, address, status, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?1, 'Local Older', '1990-01-01', 'MALE', 'V-B',
                     NULL, NULL, NULL, 'ACTIVE', '2099-01-01 00:00:00', '2099-01-01 00:00:00')",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("seed");

        let master_device = "master-device-id-2";
        let entry = crate::repo::OutboxEntry {
            id: "e2".into(),
            device_id: master_device.into(),
            seq: 1,
            entity_table: "patient".into(),
            entity_id: id.into(),
            op: "UPDATE".into(),
            payload_json: format!(
                r#"{{"id":"{id}","name":"Master Newer","updated_at":"2099-02-01T00:00:00Z"}}"#
            ),
            created_at: "2099-02-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
        };

        SyncEngine::ingest_push(&pool, master_device, std::slice::from_ref(&entry))
            .await
            .expect("ingest");

        let name: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT name FROM patient WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(id)
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("read back");

            name, "Master Newer",
            "older local row must yield to newer master push"
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn master_forwards_its_row_not_a_stale_replica_payload() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.expect("schema");
        save_deployment(
            &pool,
            &crate::deployment::SyncDeploymentConfig {
                schema_version: 1,
                mode: crate::deployment::DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
                role: crate::deployment::DeviceRole::Master,
                device_label: "Main".into(),
                ..Default::default()
            },
        )
        .await
        .expect("deploy");
        let local = ensure_local_device(&pool, "Main").await.expect("device");
        let id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1";
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number, status, updated_at)
             VALUES (?1, 'Master Newer', '1990-01-01', 'MALE', 'V-STALE', 'ACTIVE', '2099-03-01 00:00:00')",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("seed");
        let entry = crate::repo::OutboxEntry {
            id: "stale".into(),
            device_id: "replica-a".into(),
            seq: 4,
            entity_table: "patient".into(),
            entity_id: id.into(),
            op: "UPDATE".into(),
            payload_json: format!(
                r#"{{"id":"{id}","name":"Stale Replica","updated_at":"2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}"#
            ),
            created_at: "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
        };
        SyncEngine::ingest_push(&pool, "replica-a", std::slice::from_ref(&entry))
            .await
            .expect("ingest");
        let name: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT name FROM patient WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(id)
            .fetch_one(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(name, "Master Newer");
        let forwarded = crate::repo::list_entries_since(&pool, &local, 0)
            .await
            .expect("outbox");
        let row = forwarded
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.entity_id == id)
            .expect("stale push must still be relayed from the master's current row");
        assert!(row.payload_json.contains("Master Newer"));
        assert!(!row.payload_json.contains("Stale Replica"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn align_moves_pending_outbox_onto_the_activation_token_device() {
        use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
        use rand::rngs::OsRng;

        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
        run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.expect("schema");
        let signing_key = SigningKey::generate(&mut OsRng);
        let previous_secret = std::env::var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET").ok();
        std::env::set_var(
            "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
            "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
        );
        let fingerprint = crate::cluster::crypto::DeviceIdentity::try_load()
            .expect("identity")
            .expect("loaded")
            .fingerprint;
        let foreign = crate::pairing::mint_activation_token(
            &signing_key,
            &crate::pairing::ActivationTokenPayload {
                version: 2,
                device_id: "not-this-install".into(),
                slave_label: "Replica".into(),
                master_device_id: "master".into(),
                allowed_actions: vec!["sync.push".into()],
                issued_at: "2026-11-06T00:00:00Z".into(),
                nonce: "n".into(),
            },
        )
        .expect("mint");
        medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::set(
            &pool,
            crate::deployment::APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY,
            "local-wrong",
        )
        .await
        .expect("kv");
        ensure_local_device(&pool, "Replica").await.expect("device");
        crate::repo::append_outbox(
            &pool,
            "local-wrong",
            "app_kv",
            "pending-key",
            "INSERT",
            r#"{"key":"pending-key","value":"1"}"#,
        )
        .await
        .expect("outbox");
        let mut cfg = crate::deployment::SyncDeploymentConfig {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: crate::deployment::DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
            role: crate::deployment::DeviceRole::Replica,
            device_label: "Replica".into(),
            activation_token: foreign,
            master_pubkey: crate::master_keys::pubkey_b64(&signing_key),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let kept = align_local_id_to_activation(&pool, &cfg)
            .await
            .expect("foreign token");
        assert_eq!(kept, "local-wrong");
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO pairing_request (id, device_id, slave_pubkey, fingerprint)
             VALUES ('join-paired', 'paired-fp', '', 'paired-fp')",
        )
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("pairing row");
        let paired = crate::pairing::mint_activation_token(
            &signing_key,
            &crate::pairing::ActivationTokenPayload {
                version: 2,
                device_id: "paired-fp".into(),
                slave_label: "Replica".into(),
                master_device_id: "master".into(),
                allowed_actions: vec!["sync.push".into()],
                issued_at: "2026-11-06T00:00:00Z".into(),
                nonce: "paired".into(),
            },
        )
        .expect("mint paired token");
        cfg.activation_token = paired;
        let adopted = align_local_id_to_activation(&pool, &cfg)
            .await
            .expect("joined token");
        assert_eq!(adopted, "paired-fp");
        let token = crate::pairing::mint_activation_token(
            &signing_key,
            &crate::pairing::ActivationTokenPayload {
                version: 2,
                device_id: fingerprint.clone(),
                slave_label: "Replica".into(),
                master_device_id: "master".into(),
                allowed_actions: vec!["sync.push".into()],
                issued_at: "2026-11-06T00:00:00Z".into(),
                nonce: "n2".into(),
            },
        )
        .expect("mint fingerprint token");
        cfg.activation_token = token;
        let id = align_local_id_to_activation(&pool, &cfg)
            .await
            .expect("align");
        assert_eq!(id, fingerprint);
        let pending = crate::repo::list_pending_outbox(&pool, &fingerprint, 500)
            .await
            .expect("pending");
        assert_eq!(pending.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(pending[0].device_id, fingerprint);
        let stored = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(
            &pool,
            crate::deployment::APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY,
        )
        .await
        .expect("read")
        .expect("device id");
        assert_eq!(stored, fingerprint);
        if let Some(previous) = previous_secret {
            std::env::set_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET", previous);
        } else {
            std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
        }
        let wrong: i64 =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_outbox WHERE device_id = 'local-wrong'")
                .fetch_one(&pool)
                .await
                .expect("count");
        assert_eq!(wrong, 0);
    }
}

//! MeDoc serverless / peer replication.
//!
//! Devices keep a local SQLCipher database. Mutations are appended to an
//! **outbox** with a per-device sequence. A designated **master** device
//! arbitrates conflicts; **replicas** queue changes while offline and push
//! when the master is reachable (direct HTTPS on the LAN — no central server).

pub mod cluster;
pub mod deployment;
pub mod engine;
pub mod master_keys;
pub mod merge;
pub mod net;
pub mod numbering;
pub mod pairing;
pub mod ports;
pub mod reconcile;
pub mod repo;
pub mod schema;
pub mod tls_pin;
pub mod watch;

pub use merge::ConflictPolicy;

    ActivationTokenPayload, PairingDecideResult, PairingDecision, PairingRequest,
    PairingRequestSubmit, ACTIVATION_TOKEN_PREFIX, DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ACTIONS,
};
