use std::collections::HashMap;

use chrono::Utc;
use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::deployment::{
    DeviceRole, SyncDeploymentConfig, APP_KV_DEPLOYMENT_KEY, APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY,
};
use crate::schema::ensure_sync_tables;

use super::types::{is_synced_table, synced_tables, OutboxEntry, SyncPeer, SyncStatusSnapshot};

pub async fn ensure_local_device(pool: &SqlitePool, label: &str) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let display_name = if label.is_empty() {
        "This device"
    } else {
        label
    };
    let existing =
        medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(pool, APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY).await?;
    if let Some(id) = existing.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        let stored_role: Option<String> =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT role FROM sync_device WHERE device_id = ?1")
                .bind(&id)
                .fetch_optional(pool)
                .await
                .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        let role = stored_role
            .as_deref()
            .and_then(DeviceRole::parse)
            .unwrap_or(DeviceRole::Master);
        register_device_row(pool, &id, display_name, role, true, None, None).await?;
        return Ok(id);
    }
    let legacy = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(
        pool,
        medoc_core::infrastructure::license_repo::KEY_DEVICE_ID,
    )
    .await?;
    let id = legacy
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| Uuid::new_v4().to_string());
    medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::set(pool, APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY, &id).await?;
    register_device_row(
        pool,
        &id,
        display_name,
        DeviceRole::Master,
        true,
        None,
        None,
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(id)
}

/// Point this install's sync identity at `to_id` and move the local outbox
/// with it. The activation token's `device_id` is what the master compares
/// to `fromDeviceId`; a newer local fingerprint must not keep its own id.
pub async fn adopt_local_device_id(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    from_id: &str,
    to_id: &str,
    label: &str,
    role: DeviceRole,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    if to_id.is_empty() || from_id == to_id {
        return Ok(());
    }
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let display = if label.is_empty() {
        "This device"
    } else {
        label
    };
    let mut tx = pool.begin().await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_device (device_id, display_name, role, is_local, last_seen_at)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET
           display_name = excluded.display_name,
           role = excluded.role,
           is_local = 1,
           last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
    )
    .bind(to_id)
    .bind(display)
    .bind(role.as_str())
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let max_to: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) FROM sync_outbox WHERE device_id = ?1")
            .bind(to_id)
            .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if max_to > 0 {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE sync_outbox SET seq = seq + ?1 WHERE device_id = ?2")
            .bind(max_to)
            .bind(from_id)
            .execute(&mut *tx)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    }
    sqlx::query("UPDATE sync_outbox SET device_id = ?1 WHERE device_id = ?2")
        .bind(to_id)
        .bind(from_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let from_seq: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT seq FROM sync_vector WHERE device_id = ?1), 0)",
    )
    .bind(from_id)
    .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let to_seq: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT seq FROM sync_vector WHERE device_id = ?1), 0)",
    )
    .bind(to_id)
    .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let max_out: i64 =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) FROM sync_outbox WHERE device_id = ?1")
            .bind(to_id)
            .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let merged = from_seq.max(to_seq).max(max_out);
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM sync_vector WHERE device_id = ?1")
        .bind(from_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, ?2)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = excluded.seq",
    )
    .bind(to_id)
    .bind(merged)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let occupied: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT target_device_id FROM sync_peer_vector WHERE source_device_id = ?1",
    )
    .bind(to_id)
    .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    for target in occupied {
        sqlx::query(
            "DELETE FROM sync_peer_vector WHERE source_device_id = ?1 AND target_device_id = ?2",
        )
        .bind(from_id)
        .bind(&target)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    }
    sqlx::query("UPDATE sync_peer_vector SET source_device_id = ?1 WHERE source_device_id = ?2")
        .bind(to_id)
        .bind(from_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query("UPDATE sync_device SET is_local = 0 WHERE is_local = 1 AND device_id != ?1")
        .bind(to_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
         ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
    )
    .bind(APP_KV_DEVICE_ID_KEY)
    .bind(to_id)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    tx.commit().await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn load_deployment(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncDeploymentConfig, AppError> {
    let raw =
        medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(pool, APP_KV_DEPLOYMENT_KEY).await?;
    match raw {
        Some(s) => serde_json::from_str(&s)
            .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("sync.deployment.v1: {e}"))),
        None => Ok(SyncDeploymentConfig::default()),
    }
}

pub async fn save_deployment(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    cfg: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let s = serde_json::to_string(cfg)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync deployment serialise: {e}")))?;
    medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::set(pool, APP_KV_DEPLOYMENT_KEY, &s).await
}

/// Recorder helper for repository write paths.
///
/// Semantics:
///
/// 1. Looks up the current deployment. If it is not `serverless_peer`,
///    the call is a no-op (master-only practices stay on the simpler path).
/// 2. Drops any write whose table is not in [`SYNCED_TABLES`].
/// 3. Otherwise appends one row to `sync_outbox` and bumps the local vector.
///
/// Returns `Ok(())` in all cases so callers can `?` it from their write
/// paths without changing return types.
pub async fn sync_record_or_noop(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entity_table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
    op: &str,
    payload_json: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    if !is_synced_table(entity_table) {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await.unwrap_or_default();
    let peer_mode = deployment.mode == crate::deployment::DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer;
    let replica_joined: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_device
         WHERE is_local = 0
           AND (role = 'REPLICA' OR seat_role = 'MEMBER')",
    )
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap_or(0);
    if !peer_mode && replica_joined == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
    append_outbox(pool, &local_id, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json).await?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn append_outbox(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    entity_table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
    op: &str,
    payload_json: &str,
) -> Result<OutboxEntry, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let seq: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "INSERT INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, 1)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1
         RETURNING seq",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let id = Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let created_at = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_outbox (id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)",
    )
    .bind(&id)
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(seq)
    .bind(entity_table)
    .bind(entity_id)
    .bind(op)
    .bind(payload_json)
    .bind(&created_at)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    Ok(OutboxEntry {
        id,
        device_id: device_id.to_string(),
        seq,
        entity_table: entity_table.to_string(),
        entity_id: entity_id.to_string(),
        op: op.to_string(),
        payload_json: payload_json.to_string(),
        created_at,
    })
}

pub async fn list_pending_outbox(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    limit: i64,
) -> Result<Vec<OutboxEntry>, AppError> {
    let rows = sqlx::query_as::<_, (String, String, i64, String, String, String, String, String)>(
        "SELECT id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at
         FROM sync_outbox
         WHERE device_id = ?1 AND delivered_at IS NULL
           AND (fail_reason IS NULL OR fail_reason = '')
         ORDER BY seq ASC
         LIMIT ?2",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(limit)
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    Ok(rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(
            |(id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at)| {
                OutboxEntry {
                    id,
                    device_id,
                    seq,
                    entity_table,
                    entity_id,
                    op,
                    payload_json,
                    created_at,
                }
            },
        )
        .collect())
}

pub async fn mark_outbox_delivered(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    through_seq: i64,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
    sqlx::query(
        "UPDATE sync_outbox SET delivered_at = ?1
         WHERE device_id = ?2 AND seq <= ?3 AND delivered_at IS NULL",
    )
    .bind(&now)
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(through_seq)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn mark_outbox_failed(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entry_id: &str,
    reason: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query("UPDATE sync_outbox SET fail_reason = ?1 WHERE id = ?2")
        .bind(reason)
        .bind(entry_id)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Outbox rows from `source_device_id` not yet pushed to `target_device_id` (mesh).
pub async fn list_pending_outbox_for_peer(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    target_device_id: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<OutboxEntry>, AppError> {
    let since: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COALESCE(through_seq, 0) FROM sync_peer_vector
         WHERE source_device_id = ?1 AND target_device_id = ?2",
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(target_device_id)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?
    .unwrap_or(0);

    let rows = sqlx::query_as::<_, (String, String, i64, String, String, String, String, String)>(
        "SELECT id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at
         FROM sync_outbox
         WHERE device_id = ?1 AND seq > ?2
           AND (fail_reason IS NULL OR fail_reason = '')
         ORDER BY seq ASC"
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(since)
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    Ok(rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(
            |(id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at)| {
                OutboxEntry {
                    id,
                    device_id,
                    seq,
                    entity_table,
                    entity_id,
                    op,
                    payload_json,
                    created_at,
                }
            },
        )
        .collect())
}

pub async fn mark_peer_delivery(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    target_device_id: &str,
    through_seq: i64,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_peer_vector (source_device_id, target_device_id, through_seq, updated_at)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
         ON CONFLICT(source_device_id, target_device_id) DO UPDATE SET
           through_seq = MAX(sync_peer_vector.through_seq, excluded.through_seq),
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(target_device_id)
    .bind(through_seq)
    .bind(&now)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn list_entries_since(

    Ok(rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(

                OutboxEntry {
                    id,
                    device_id,
                    seq,
                    entity_table,
                    entity_id,
                    op,
                    payload_json,
                    created_at,
                }
            },
        )
        .collect())
}

/// Keys that decide how the appointment calendar is drawn: hours, closures,
/// blocked times, and appointment preferences (buffer, colours, reminders).
const CALENDAR_CONTROL_KV_KEYS: &[&str] = &[
    "practice.work_hours.v1",
    "practice.blockedTimes.v1",
    "practice.preferences.v1",
    "practice.preferences-appointment.v1",
    "practice.calendar-workflows.v1",
];

/// Queue the current calendar controls so the other device can apply the
/// newer copy. Safe to call once per launch; later edits are recorded on write.
pub async fn enqueue_calendar_controls(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
    if deployment.mode != crate::deployment::DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
    let mut queued = 0u32;
    for key in CALENDAR_CONTROL_KV_KEYS {
        let row: Option<(String, String)> =
            sqlx::query_as("SELECT value, updated_at FROM app_kv WHERE key = ?1")
                .bind(key)
                .fetch_optional(pool)
                .await
                .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        let Some((value, updated_at)) = row else {
            continue;
        };
        let payload = serde_json::json!({
            "key": key,
            "value": value,
            "updated_at": updated_at,
        });
        append_outbox(
            pool,
            &local_id,
            "app_kv",
            key,
            "UPDATE",
            &payload.to_string(),
        )
        .await?;
        queued += 1;
    }
    queued += snapshot_table(pool, &local_id, "absence").await?;
    Ok(queued)
}

/// Dump current practice rows into the outbox so a replica can pull a full initial package.
pub async fn enqueue_full_snapshot(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
    let local_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
    let mut queued = 0u32;
    for table in synced_tables() {
        queued += snapshot_table(pool, &local_id, table).await?;
    }
    tracing::info!(
        target: "medoc::sync",
        event = "SYNC_SNAPSHOT_QUEUED",
        rows = queued
    );
    Ok(queued)
}

async fn snapshot_table(pool: &SqlitePool, device_id: &str, table: &str) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let cols: Vec<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('{table}')"))
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if cols.is_empty() {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    // F146/F147: entity id is not always column `id` (hint, preference, chart_validation).
    let key = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::key_expr(table);
    if medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::key_is_column(table) {
        let id_col = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::id_column(table);
        if !cols.iter().any(|c| c == id_col) {
            return Ok(0);
        }
    } else if !(cols.iter().any(|c| c == "patient_id") && cols.iter().any(|c| c == "section_or_item"))
    {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    let mut from_sql = table.to_string();
    if table == "app_kv" {
        from_sql.push_str(
            " WHERE key NOT LIKE 'sync.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'license.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'pairing.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'onboarding.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'cluster.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'company.portal.%'",
        );
    }
    let count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {from_sql}"))
        .fetch_one(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if count <= 0 {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, 0)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO NOTHING",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let new_max: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "UPDATE sync_vector SET seq = seq + ?2 WHERE device_id = ?1 RETURNING seq",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(count)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let seq_base = new_max - count;
    let json_expr = snapshot_pairs(table, &cols);
    let created_at = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
    let insert_sql = format!(
        "INSERT INTO sync_outbox (id, device_id, seq, entity_table, entity_id, op, payload_json, created_at)
         SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?1, ?2 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY {key}),
                ?3, CAST({key} AS TEXT), 'UPDATE', {json_expr}, ?4
         FROM {from_sql}"
    );
    sqlx::query(&insert_sql)
        .bind(device_id)
        .bind(seq_base)
        .bind(table)
        .bind(&created_at)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(count as u32)
}

fn snapshot_pairs(table: &str, cols: &[String]) -> String {
    medoc_core::infrastructure::database::recorded_write::json_object_sql(table, cols)
}

fn is_private_app_kv_key(key: &str) -> bool {
    medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::deny_app_kv_key(key)
}

/// JSON object for one live row, using the same `json_object` shape as a snapshot.
/// `None` when the table is not synced or the row is gone.
pub async fn load_row_payload_json(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
) -> Result<Option<String>, AppError> {
    if !is_synced_table(table) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let key = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::key_expr(table);
    let cols: Vec<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('{table}')"))
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if cols.is_empty() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if table == "app_kv" && is_private_app_kv_key(entity_id) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let json_expr = snapshot_pairs(table, &cols);
    let sql = format!("SELECT {json_expr} FROM \"{table}\" WHERE {key} = ?1");
    let json: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(&sql)
        .bind(entity_id)
        .fetch_optional(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(json.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()))
}

/// Remember the highest seq observed from a remote device (replica pull cursor).
pub async fn set_observed_seq(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    seq: i64,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_device (device_id, display_name, role, is_local)
         VALUES (?1, 'Main', 'MASTER', 0)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO NOTHING",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, ?2)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET
           seq = CASE WHEN excluded.seq > sync_vector.seq THEN excluded.seq ELSE sync_vector.seq END",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(seq)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

/// How many times this pulled row has failed to apply. Starts at 1.
pub async fn record_pull_failure(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    source_seq: i64,
) -> Result<i64, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let attempts: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "INSERT INTO sync_pull_failure (source_device_id, source_seq, attempts)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, 1)
         ON CONFLICT(source_device_id, source_seq) DO UPDATE SET
           attempts = attempts + 1
         RETURNING attempts",
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(source_seq)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(attempts)
}

pub async fn clear_pull_failure(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    source_seq: i64,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM sync_pull_failure WHERE source_device_id = ?1 AND source_seq = ?2")
        .bind(source_device_id)
        .bind(source_seq)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn was_applied(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    source_seq: i64,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let n: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_applied WHERE source_device_id = ?1 AND source_seq = ?2",
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(source_seq)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(n > 0)
}

pub async fn mark_applied(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    source_device_id: &str,
    source_seq: i64,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_applied (source_device_id, source_seq) VALUES (?1, ?2)",
    )
    .bind(source_device_id)
    .bind(source_seq)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn all_vectors(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<HashMap<String, i64>, AppError> {
    let rows = sqlx::query_as::<_, (String, i64)>(
        "SELECT device_id, seq FROM sync_vector ORDER BY device_id",
    )
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(rows.into_iter().collect())
}

pub async fn status_snapshot(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<SyncStatusSnapshot, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let deployment = load_deployment(pool).await?;
    let local_device_id = ensure_local_device(pool, &deployment.device_label).await?;
    let local_seq: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT seq FROM sync_vector WHERE device_id = ?1), 0)",
    )
    .bind(&local_device_id)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let pending_outbox: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_outbox WHERE device_id = ?1 AND delivered_at IS NULL",
    )
    .bind(&local_device_id)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    let peers = list_peers(pool).await?;
    let vectors = all_vectors(pool).await?;
    Ok(SyncStatusSnapshot {
        local_device_id,
        deployment,
        local_seq,
        pending_outbox,
        peers,
        vectors,
    })
}

/// Refresh replica `last_seen_at` and LAN base URL after a successful push.
pub async fn touch_replica_seen(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    peer_ip: &str,
    http_port: u16,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let peer_base_url = crate::pairing::peer_base_url_from_ip(peer_ip, http_port);
    sqlx::query(
        "UPDATE sync_device SET last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            peer_base_url = COALESCE(?1, peer_base_url)
         WHERE device_id = ?2",
    )
    .bind(peer_base_url)
    .bind(device_id)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn register_peer(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    display_name: &str,
    role: DeviceRole,
    peer_base_url: Option<&str>,
    peer_cert_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    register_device_row(
        pool,
        device_id,
        display_name,
        role,
        false,
        peer_base_url,
        peer_cert_sha256,
    )
    .await
}

pub async fn register_local_device(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    display_name: &str,
    role: DeviceRole,
    peer_base_url: Option<&str>,
    peer_cert_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    register_device_row(
        pool,
        device_id,
        display_name,
        role,
        true,
        peer_base_url,
        peer_cert_sha256,
    )
    .await
}

async fn register_device_row(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    device_id: &str,
    display_name: &str,
    role: DeviceRole,
    is_local: bool,
    peer_base_url: Option<&str>,
    peer_cert_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_device (device_id, display_name, role, is_local, peer_base_url, peer_cert_sha256, last_seen_at)
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET
           display_name = excluded.display_name,
           role = excluded.role,
           is_local = excluded.is_local,
           peer_base_url = COALESCE(excluded.peer_base_url, sync_device.peer_base_url),
           peer_cert_sha256 = COALESCE(excluded.peer_cert_sha256, sync_device.peer_cert_sha256),
           last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind(display_name)
    .bind(role.as_str())
    .bind(if is_local { 1 } else { 0 })
    .bind(peer_base_url)
    .bind(peer_cert_sha256)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    sqlx::query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_vector (device_id, seq) VALUES (?1, 0)")
        .bind(device_id)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn list_peers(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<Vec<SyncPeer>, AppError> {
    let rows = sqlx::query_as::<_, (String, String, String, Option<String>, Option<String>)>(
        "SELECT device_id, display_name, role, peer_base_url, last_seen_at
         FROM sync_device ORDER BY is_local DESC, display_name ASC",
    )
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(
            |(device_id, display_name, role, peer_base_url, last_seen_at)| SyncPeer {
                device_id,
                display_name,
                role,
                peer_base_url,
                last_seen_at,
            },
        )
        .collect())
}

//! Sync replication DTOs and allow-list constants.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

/// Idempotent DDL for peer replication tables (practice `medoc.db` only).
pub async fn ensure_sync_tables(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_device (
            device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MASTER' CHECK (role IN ('MASTER','REPLICA')),
            is_local INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_local IN (0, 1)),
            peer_base_url TEXT,
            peer_cert_sha256 TEXT,
            last_seen_at TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_vector (
            device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sync_device(device_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_outbox (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
            entity_table TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            op TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE')),
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            delivered_at TEXT,
            UNIQUE(device_id, seq)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    let _ = sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE sync_outbox ADD COLUMN fail_reason TEXT")
        .execute(pool)
        .await;
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_outbox_pending ON sync_outbox(device_id, delivered_at)",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_applied (
            source_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
            applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (source_device_id, source_seq)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_pull_failure (
            source_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
            attempts INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (source_device_id, source_seq)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_watch_seen (
            entity_table TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            stamp TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (entity_table, entity_id)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_peer_vector (
            source_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            target_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            through_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (source_device_id, target_device_id)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    // Pairing request inbox (master holds; replicas write via /api/v1/pairing/request).
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pairing_request (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            slave_pubkey TEXT NOT NULL,
            slave_label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            requester_ip TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','ACCEPTED','REJECTED','REVOKED')) DEFAULT 'PENDING',
            allowed_actions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            activation_token TEXT,
            requested_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            decided_at TEXT,
            decided_by TEXT
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pairing_request_status ON pairing_request(status, requested_at)",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pairing_request_device ON pairing_request(device_id)",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    // Per-slave authorised actions (kept in sync with the latest accepted pairing
    // request; queried by the LAN router's activation-token middleware).
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS slave_permission (
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            action TEXT NOT NULL,
            granted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            granted_by TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (device_id, action)
        )",
    )
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;

    migrate_pairing_pin_columns(pool).await?;

    medoc_core::infrastructure::database::migrations::ensure_cluster_tables(pool).await?;

    Ok(())
}

async fn migrate_pairing_pin_columns(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let has_hash: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('pairing_request') WHERE name = 'confirm_pin_hash'",
    )
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if has_hash == Some(0) {
        sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE pairing_request ADD COLUMN confirm_pin_hash TEXT")
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE pairing_request ADD COLUMN confirm_pin_expires_at TEXT")
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        sqlx::query(
            "ALTER TABLE pairing_request ADD COLUMN confirm_pin_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
        )
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        sqlx::query("ALTER TABLE pairing_request ADD COLUMN transport TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lan'")
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

FILE: crates/shared/medoc-sync/src/tls_pin.rs

//! HTTPS client that accepts a LAN certificate only when its SHA-256 matches
//! the fingerprint stored at pairing. An empty pin is a hard error.

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use rustls::client::danger::{HandshakeSignatureValid, ServerCertVerified, ServerCertVerifier};
use rustls::pki_types::{CertificateDer, ServerName, UnixTime};
use rustls::{DigitallySignedStruct, SignatureScheme};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::deployment::APP_KV_LAN_TLS_PIN;

pub fn certificate_pin_matches(der: &[u8], expected_hex: &str) -> bool {
    let digest = Sha256::digest(der);
    let actual: String = digest.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
    actual == normalize_sha256_pin(expected_hex)
}

/// Lowercase hex only. Colons and spaces from a copied fingerprint are ignored.
pub fn normalize_sha256_pin(raw: &str) -> String {
    raw.chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit())
        .collect::<String>()
        .to_ascii_lowercase()
}

pub fn is_sha256_pin(raw: &str) -> bool {
    normalize_sha256_pin(raw).len() == 64
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct PinVerifier {
    expected_hex: String,
}

impl ServerCertVerifier for PinVerifier {
    fn verify_server_cert(
        &self,
        end_entity: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        _intermediates: &[CertificateDer<'_>],
        _server_name: &ServerName<'_>,
        _ocsp_response: &[u8],
        _now: UnixTime,
    ) -> Result<ServerCertVerified, rustls::Error> {
        if certificate_pin_matches(end_entity.as_ref(), &self.expected_hex) {
            Ok(ServerCertVerified::assertion())
        } else {
            Err(rustls::Error::General(
                "certificate pin mismatch".into(),
            ))
        }
    }

    fn verify_tls12_signature(
        &self,
        message: &[u8],
        cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        dss: &DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        rustls::crypto::verify_tls12_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider().signature_verification_algorithms,
        )
    }

    fn verify_tls13_signature(
        &self,
        message: &[u8],
        cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        dss: &DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        rustls::crypto::verify_tls13_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider().signature_verification_algorithms,
        )
    }

    fn supported_verify_schemes(&self) -> Vec<SignatureScheme> {
        rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider()
            .signature_verification_algorithms
            .supported_schemes()
    }
}

/// Remember this install's LAN certificate fingerprint so join can hand it to replicas.
pub async fn remember_local_pin(pool: &SqlitePool, fingerprint: &str) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let pin = normalize_sha256_pin(fingerprint);
    if !is_sha256_pin(&pin) {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "LAN TLS pin is not a SHA-256 fingerprint".into(),
        ));
    }
    app_kv_repo::set(pool, APP_KV_LAN_TLS_PIN, &pin).await
}

pub async fn load_local_pin(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Option<String> {
    let raw = app_kv_repo::get(pool, APP_KV_LAN_TLS_PIN).await.ok()??;
    let pin = normalize_sha256_pin(&raw);
    is_sha256_pin(&pin).then_some(pin)
}

/// Build a client that checks `cert_sha256` and rejects every other certificate.
pub fn pinned_http_client(cert_sha256: &str, timeout: Duration) -> Result<reqwest::Client, AppError> {
    let pin = normalize_sha256_pin(cert_sha256);
    if !is_sha256_pin(&pin) {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "sync TLS pin missing — refusing to accept an unpinned certificate".into(),
        ));
    }
    let provider = Arc::new(rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider());
    let verifier = Arc::new(PinVerifier { expected_hex: pin });
    let config = rustls::ClientConfig::builder_with_provider(provider)
        .with_safe_default_protocol_versions()
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("tls versions: {e}")))?
        .dangerous()
        .with_custom_certificate_verifier(verifier)
        .with_no_client_auth();
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(timeout)
        .use_preconfigured_tls(config)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("sync http client: {e}")))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{certificate_pin_matches, pinned_http_client};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use std::time::Duration;

    #[test]
    fn pin_matches_the_certificate_bytes_only() {
        let der = b"practice-certificate";
        let digest = Sha256::digest(der);
        let hex: String = digest.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
        assert!(certificate_pin_matches(der, &hex));
        assert!(certificate_pin_matches(der, &hex.to_ascii_uppercase()));
        assert!(!certificate_pin_matches(der, &"ab".repeat(32)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn colon_separated_fingerprint_is_a_pin() {
        let hex = "ab".repeat(32);
        let colon: String = hex
            .as_bytes()
            .chunks(2)
            .map(|pair| std::str::from_utf8(pair).unwrap())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(":");
        assert!(super::is_sha256_pin(&colon));
        assert!(pinned_http_client(&colon, Duration::from_secs(1)).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_pin_is_refused() {
        let err = pinned_http_client("", Duration::from_secs(1)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.to_string().contains("unpinned"));
        assert!(pinned_http_client(&"ab".repeat(32), Duration::from_secs(1)).is_ok());
    }
}

FILE: crates/shared/medoc-sync/src/watch.rs

//! Background scan of the tables the admin device and a joined user device share.
//!
//! Repository writes already append to `sync_outbox`. This scan catches a shared
//! row whose `updated_at` moved without that hook, queues it, and leaves the
//! caller to send the queue to the other device immediately.
//!
//! The first pass only records what is already on disk. Rows applied from the
//! other device are marked seen in [`note_remote_applied`] so they are not
//! queued back.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::deployment::DeploymentMode;
use crate::repo::{self, is_synced_table, synced_tables};
use crate::schema::ensure_sync_tables;

const BASELINE_KEY: &str = "sync.watch.baseline.v1";

/// How many shared rows changed since the last observation.
///
/// `0` when replication is off, or on the first pass (that pass only records
/// the current rows). A count above zero means the outbox now holds those
/// changes, or they were already waiting there from the write hook.
pub async fn queue_shared_changes(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    if !replication_active(pool).await? {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    if !baseline_done(pool).await? {
        remember_current(pool).await?;
        write_baseline(pool).await?;
        tracing::info!(target: "medoc::sync", event = "SHARED_SYNC_BASELINE");
        return Ok(0);
    }
    diff_and_queue(pool).await
}

/// Remember a row that just arrived from the other device so the next scan
/// does not queue it again.
pub async fn note_remote_applied(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    entity_table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    if !is_synced_table(entity_table) {
        return Ok(());
    }
    ensure_sync_tables(pool).await?;
    let Some(stamp) = row_stamp(pool, entity_table, entity_id).await? else {
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM sync_watch_seen WHERE entity_table = ?1 AND entity_id = ?2")
            .bind(entity_table)
            .bind(entity_id)
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(());
    };
    upsert_seen(pool, entity_table, entity_id, &stamp).await
}

async fn replication_active(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let deployment = repo::load_deployment(pool).await.unwrap_or_default();
    if deployment.mode == DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    let joined: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_device
         WHERE is_local = 0
           AND (role = 'REPLICA' OR seat_role = 'MEMBER')",
    )
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap_or(0);
    Ok(joined > 0)
}

async fn baseline_done(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let value: Option<String> =
        medoc_core::infrastructure::database::app_kv_repo::get(pool, BASELINE_KEY).await?;
    Ok(value.as_deref() == Some("1"))
}

async fn write_baseline(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?1, '1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
         ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = '1', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
    )
    .bind(BASELINE_KEY)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn remember_current(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM sync_watch_seen")
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    for table in synced_tables() {
        for (id, stamp) in list_stamps(pool, table).await? {
            upsert_seen(pool, table, &id, &stamp).await?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn diff_and_queue(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let mut changes = 0u32;
    for table in synced_tables() {
        let current = list_stamps(pool, table).await?;
        let seen = seen_stamps(pool, table).await?;
        for (id, stamp) in &current {
            if seen.get(id).map(String::as_str) == Some(stamp.as_str()) {
                continue;
            }
            changes += 1;
            if let Some(payload) = repo::load_row_payload_json(pool, table, id).await? {
                repo::sync_record_or_noop(pool, table, id, "UPDATE", &payload).await?;
            }
            upsert_seen(pool, table, id, stamp).await?;
        }
        for id in seen.keys() {
            if current.contains_key(id) {
                continue;
            }
            changes += 1;
            repo::sync_record_or_noop(pool, table, id, "DELETE", "{}").await?;
            sqlx::query("DELETE FROM sync_watch_seen WHERE entity_table = ?1 AND entity_id = ?2")
                .bind(table)
                .bind(id)
                .execute(pool)
                .await
                .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(changes)
}

async fn stamp_select(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
) -> Result<Option<(String, String)>, AppError> {
    let cols: Vec<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('{table}')"))
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    if cols.is_empty() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let key = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::key_expr(table);
    if medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::key_is_column(table) {
        let id_col = medoc_core::infrastructure::database::sync_registry::id_column(table);
        if !cols.iter().any(|c| c == id_col) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
    }
    let stamp_sql = if cols.iter().any(|c| c == "updated_at") {
        "COALESCE(CAST(updated_at AS TEXT), '')".to_string()
    } else if cols.iter().any(|c| c == "created_at") {
        "COALESCE(CAST(created_at AS TEXT), '')".to_string()
    } else {
        "''".to_string()
    };
    Ok(Some((key, stamp_sql)))
}

async fn list_stamps(pool: &SqlitePool, table: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, AppError> {
    if !is_synced_table(table) {
        return Ok(HashMap::new());
    }
    let Some((key, stamp_sql)) = stamp_select(pool, table).await? else {
        return Ok(HashMap::new());
    };
    let mut from_sql = format!("\"{table}\"");
    if table == "app_kv" {
        from_sql.push_str(
            " WHERE key NOT LIKE 'sync.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'license.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'pairing.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'onboarding.%'
               AND key NOT LIKE 'cluster.%'",
        );
    }
    let sql = format!("SELECT CAST({key} AS TEXT), {stamp_sql} FROM {from_sql}");
    let rows: Vec<(String, String)> = sqlx::query_as(&sql)
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(rows.into_iter().collect())
}

async fn seen_stamps(pool: &SqlitePool, table: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, AppError> {
    let rows: Vec<(String, String)> =
        sqlx::query_as("SELECT entity_id, stamp FROM sync_watch_seen WHERE entity_table = ?1")
            .bind(table)
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(rows.into_iter().collect())
}

async fn row_stamp(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
) -> Result<Option<String>, AppError> {
    if !is_synced_table(table) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let Some((key, stamp_sql)) = stamp_select(pool, table).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let sql = format!("SELECT {stamp_sql} FROM \"{table}\" WHERE {key} = ?1");
    let stamp: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(&sql)
        .bind(entity_id)
        .fetch_optional(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(stamp)
}

async fn upsert_seen(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    entity_id: &str,
    stamp: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_watch_seen (entity_table, entity_id, stamp) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)
         ON CONFLICT(entity_table, entity_id) DO UPDATE SET stamp = excluded.stamp",
    )
    .bind(table)
    .bind(entity_id)
    .bind(stamp)
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::deployment::{DeploymentMode, DeviceRole, SyncDeploymentConfig};
    use crate::schema::ensure_sync_tables;
    use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};

    async fn enable_peer(pool: &SqlitePool) {
        let mut cfg = SyncDeploymentConfig::default();
        cfg.mode = DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer;
        cfg.role = DeviceRole::Replica;
        cfg.device_label = "watch-test".into();
        repo::save_deployment(pool, &cfg).await.unwrap();
    }

    async fn outbox_ops(pool: &SqlitePool, id: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT op FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity_table = 'app_kv' AND entity_id = ?1 ORDER BY seq",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn queues_a_shared_row_once_then_a_later_edit_and_a_delete() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.unwrap();
        run_migrations(&pool).await.unwrap();
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.unwrap();
        enable_peer(&pool).await;

        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 0);

        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('practice.watch.test', 'a', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')",
        )
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 1);
        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 0);
        assert_eq!(
            outbox_ops(&pool, "practice.watch.test").await,
            vec!["UPDATE".to_string()]
        );

        sqlx::query(
            "UPDATE app_kv SET value = 'b', updated_at = '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z' WHERE key = 'practice.watch.test'",
        )
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
        note_remote_applied(&pool, "app_kv", "practice.watch.test")
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 0);

        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM app_kv WHERE key = 'practice.watch.test'")
            .execute(&pool)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 1);
        assert_eq!(
            outbox_ops(&pool, "practice.watch.test").await,
            vec!["UPDATE".to_string(), "DELETE".to_string()]
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn stays_quiet_when_replication_is_off() {
        let pool = test_memory_pool().await.unwrap();
        run_migrations(&pool).await.unwrap();
        ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.unwrap();
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO app_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('practice.watch.off', 'a', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')",
        )
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(queue_shared_changes(&pool).await.unwrap(), 0);
        assert!(outbox_ops(&pool, "practice.watch.off").await.is_empty());
    }
}

use std::net::IpAddr;

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn xx_handshake_over_tcp_matches_transcript() {
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0")
        .await
        .expect("bind");
    let addr = listener.local_addr().expect("addr");
    let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().await.expect("accept");
        run_xx_responder(&mut stream).await.expect("responder")
    });
    let mut client = TcpStream::connect(addr).await.expect("connect");
    let (_t1, tr1) = run_xx_initiator(&mut client).await.expect("initiator");
    let (_t2, tr2) = server.await.expect("server");
    assert_eq!(tr1, tr2);
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn join_request_accept_over_loopback() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = pool.clone();

    let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.expect("accept");
        handle_join_connection(stream, pool_clone).await;
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    server.await.expect("server done");

    assert!(!outcome.session_id.is_empty());
    assert!(!outcome.handshake_transcript.is_empty());

    let pending = list_pending_requests(&pool).await.expect("pending");
    assert_eq!(pending.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pending[0].fingerprint, identity.fingerprint);

    let stored_b64: Option<String> =
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT handshake_transcript_b64 FROM pairing_request WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(&pending[0].id)
            .fetch_optional(&pool)
            .await
            .expect("select transcript");
    let stored = stored_b64.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()).map(|s| {
        base64::Engine::decode(&base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, s.trim())
            .expect("decode stored transcript")
    });
    assert_eq!(
        stored.as_deref(),
        Some(outcome.handshake_transcript.as_slice()),
        "admin must persist the same Noise transcript the joiner uses for SAS"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        derive_sas_from_transcript(stored.as_ref().unwrap()),
        derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript)
    );

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn replica_sas_uses_stored_transcript_not_ipc_garbage() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let replica_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();

    let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.expect("accept");
        handle_join_connection(stream, pool_clone).await;
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    server.await.expect("server done");

    mirror_join_session(
        &replica_pool,
        &outcome.session_id,
        &outcome.fingerprint,
        SeatRole::Member,
        &outcome.handshake_transcript,
    )
    .await
    .expect("mirror");

    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    let handle = PairingHandle {
        session_id: outcome.session_id,
        fingerprint: outcome.fingerprint,
    };
    let wrong_ipc = vec![0xAAu8; 64];
    submit_sas(&replica_pool, "joiner", &handle, &digits, &wrong_ipc)
        .await
        .expect(
            "SAS must follow the join transcript stored in SQLite, not a corrupted IPC payload",
        );

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

async fn save_admin_license(pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool) -> Vec<u8> {
    let signing_key = vec![7u8; 32];
    let repos = SqliteClusterRepos { pool };
    repos
        .save(&License {
            cluster_id: "c-sas".into(),
            license_ref: "test".into(),
            signing_key_enc: signing_key.clone(),
            max_total: 10,
            max_admin: 3,
            max_member: 7,
            activated_at: Utc::now(),
        })
        .await
        .expect("license");
    signing_key
}

async fn arm_admin_sas(pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool, session_id: &str, digits: &str) {
    let signing_key = save_admin_license(pool).await;
    let sas_hash = hash_sas(session_id, digits, &signing_key);
    SqliteClusterRepos { pool }
        .update_state(session_id, PairingStatus::AwaitingSas, Some(&sas_hash))
        .await
        .expect("awaiting sas");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn sas_confirm_via_spawned_cluster_handler() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let replica_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match listener.accept().await {
                Ok((stream, _)) => spawn_cluster_connection_handler(stream, pool_clone.clone()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    arm_admin_sas(&admin_pool, &outcome.session_id, &digits).await;

    confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, &digits)
        .await
        .expect("admin hash must accept the displayed SAS");
    let bad = confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, "0000").await;
    assert!(bad.is_err(), "wrong digits must fail remote SAS");

    mirror_join_session(
        &replica_pool,
        &outcome.session_id,
        &outcome.fingerprint,
        SeatRole::Member,
        &vec![0xAAu8; 64],
    )
    .await
    .expect("mirror garbage transcript");
    store_join_admin_endpoint(&replica_pool, "127.0.0.1", port)
        .await
        .expect("endpoint");
    let handle = PairingHandle {
        session_id: outcome.session_id,
        fingerprint: outcome.fingerprint,
    };
    submit_sas(&replica_pool, "joiner", &handle, &digits, &[])
        .await
        .expect("replica must accept the admin-shown SAS even if local transcript differs");

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn sas_confirm_works_when_license_exists_before_join() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    save_admin_license(&admin_pool).await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match listener.accept().await {
                Ok((stream, _)) => spawn_cluster_connection_handler(stream, pool_clone.clone()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, &digits)
        .await
        .expect("join must arm SAS hash so confirm works without a separate Accept");

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn sas_confirm_from_transcript_while_still_join_requested() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match listener.accept().await {
                Ok((stream, _)) => spawn_cluster_connection_handler(stream, pool_clone.clone()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");

    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, &digits)
        .await
        .expect("JOIN_REQUESTED plus stored transcript must still accept the handshake SAS");

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn sas_confirm_uses_transcript_when_stored_hash_is_wrong() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let signing_key = save_admin_license(&admin_pool).await;
    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match listener.accept().await {
                Ok((stream, _)) => spawn_cluster_connection_handler(stream, pool_clone.clone()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    let wrong_hash = hash_sas(&outcome.session_id, "0000", &signing_key);
    SqliteClusterRepos { pool: &admin_pool }
        .update_state(
            &outcome.session_id,
            PairingStatus::AwaitingSas,
            Some(&wrong_hash),
        )
        .await
        .expect("stale hash");
    confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, &digits)
        .await
        .expect("displayed/handshake SAS must win over a stale HMAC");

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[serial_test::serial]
async fn staff_directory_and_lan_token_after_sas() {
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET",
        "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210",
    );
    std::env::set_var(
        "MEDOC_PAIRING_MASTER_SECRET",
        "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    );

    let admin_pool = fresh_pool().await;
    save_admin_license(&admin_pool).await;

    let addr: IpAddr = "127.0.0.1".parse().unwrap();
    let listener = bind_cluster_listener(addr, 0).await.expect("bind");
    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let pool_clone = admin_pool.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match listener.accept().await {
                Ok((stream, _)) => spawn_cluster_connection_handler(stream, pool_clone.clone()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    });

    let identity = DeviceIdentity::load_or_create().expect("identity");
    let outcome = join_admin_endpoint("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, SeatRole::Member)
        .await
        .expect("join");
    let digits = derive_sas_from_transcript(&outcome.handshake_transcript);
    let lan = confirm_sas_on_admin("127.0.0.1", port, &outcome.session_id, &digits)
        .await
        .expect("sas");
    assert!(
        lan.activation_token
            .as_deref()
            .unwrap_or("")
            .starts_with("mt2."),
        "SAS confirm must return a master activation token"
    );

    let json = fetch_staff_directory("127.0.0.1", port, &identity, &outcome.session_id)
        .await
        .expect("staff directory after SAS");
    assert!(
        json.contains("staff") || json.contains('{'),
        "owner must return a staff directory payload, got {json}"
    );

    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_CLUSTER_DEVICE_SECRET");
    std::env::remove_var("MEDOC_PAIRING_MASTER_SECRET");
}

//! HTTP-path tests for `SyncEngine` push/pull/mesh (T-U1) using wiremock.

use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::connection::{run_migrations, test_memory_pool};
use medoc_sync::deployment::{DeploymentMode, DeviceRole, SyncDeploymentConfig};
use medoc_sync::engine::SyncEngine;
use medoc_sync::master_keys;
use medoc_sync::repo::{
    append_outbox, ensure_local_device, list_pending_outbox, mark_applied, save_deployment,
};

async fn deploy(
    pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool,
    cfg: &SyncDeploymentConfig,
) -> Result<(), medoc_core::error::AppError> {
    let mut cfg = cfg.clone();
    if cfg.master_cert_sha256.is_empty() {
        cfg.master_cert_sha256 = "ab".repeat(32);
    }
    save_deployment(pool, &cfg).await
}

async fn seed_peer_tls_pin(pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool, device_id: &str) {
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_device (device_id, display_name, role, is_local, peer_cert_sha256)
         VALUES (?1, ?1, 'REPLICA', 0, ?2)
         ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET peer_cert_sha256 = excluded.peer_cert_sha256",
    )
    .bind(device_id)
    .bind("ab".repeat(32))
    .execute(pool)
    .await
    .expect("peer pin");
}
use medoc_sync::schema::ensure_sync_tables;
use wiremock::matchers::{method, path};
use wiremock::{Mock, MockServer, ResponseTemplate};

async fn fresh_pool() -> sqlx::SqlitePool {
    let pool = test_memory_pool().await.expect("pool");
    run_migrations(&pool).await.expect("migrate");
    ensure_sync_tables(&pool).await.expect("sync schema");
    pool
}

async fn save_replica(pool: &sqlx::SqlitePool, master_url: &str, token: &str, label: &str) {
    deploy(
        pool,
        &SyncDeploymentConfig {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
            role: DeviceRole::Replica,
            master_base_url: master_url.into(),
            master_access_token: token.into(),
            master_cert_sha256: "ab".repeat(32),
            device_label: label.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("deployment");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn push_to_master_empty_outbox_skips_http() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let server = MockServer::start().await;
    save_replica(&pool, &server.uri(), "tok", "empty-push").await;
    let result = SyncEngine::push_to_master(&pool).await.expect("push");
    assert_eq!(result.accepted, 0);
    assert_eq!(
        server
            .received_requests()
            .await
            .as_ref()
            .map(|r| r.len())
            .unwrap_or(0),
        0
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn push_to_master_delivers_pending_and_clears_outbox() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let server = MockServer::start().await;
    save_replica(&pool, &server.uri(), "tok-push", "push-test").await;
    let device = ensure_local_device(&pool, "push-test").await.unwrap();
    append_outbox(
        &pool,
        &device,
        "app_kv",
        "http.push.key",
        "INSERT",
        r#"{"key":"http.push.key","value":"42"}"#,
    )
    .await
    .expect("outbox");

    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/push"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "accepted": 1,
            "lastSeq": 1
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    let result = SyncEngine::push_to_master(&pool).await.expect("push ok");
    assert_eq!(result.accepted, 1);
    assert_eq!(result.last_seq, 1);
    assert!(list_pending_outbox(&pool, &device, 500)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn pull_from_master_applies_remote_app_kv() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let server = MockServer::start().await;
    save_replica(&pool, &server.uri(), "tok-pull", "pull-test").await;
    let _device = ensure_local_device(&pool, "pull-test").await.unwrap();

    let remote_entry = serde_json::json!({
        "id": "pull-e1",
        "deviceId": "master-device",
        "seq": 1,
        "entityTable": "app_kv",
        "entityId": "pull.key",
        "op": "INSERT",
        "payloadJson": r#"{"key":"pull.key","value":"from-master"}"#,
        "createdAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    });

    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/pull"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "entries": [remote_entry]
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    // Seed master device id for vector lookup
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO sync_device (device_id, display_name, role, is_local)
         VALUES ('master-device', 'Master', 'MASTER', 0)",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("master row");

    let result = SyncEngine::pull_from_master(&pool).await.expect("pull");
    assert_eq!(result.applied, 1);
    let val: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT value FROM app_kv WHERE key = 'pull.key'")
        .fetch_one(&pool)
        .await
        .expect("app_kv");
    assert_eq!(val, "from-master");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn run_mesh_sync_fetches_signed_peer_list() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let server = MockServer::start().await;
    let sk = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[7u8; 32]);
    let pubkey = master_keys::pubkey_b64(&sk);
    let master_id = "master-mesh-1";

    let peers_json = serde_json::json!([{
        "deviceId": "peer-other",
        "slaveLabel": "Peer B",
        "slavePubkey": "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=",
        "peerBaseUrl": format!("{}/", server.uri())
    }]);
    let canonical = serde_json::json!({
        "masterDeviceId": master_id,
        "peers": peers_json
    });
    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&canonical).unwrap();
    let signature = master_keys::sign(&sk, &body_bytes);

    Mock::given(method("GET"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/pairing/peers"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "masterDeviceId": master_id,
            "peers": peers_json,
            "signature": signature
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/push"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "accepted": 0,
            "lastSeq": 0
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    deploy(
        &pool,
        &SyncDeploymentConfig {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
            role: DeviceRole::Replica,
            master_base_url: server.uri(),
            master_access_token: "mesh-tok".into(),
            master_pubkey: pubkey,
            master_device_id: master_id.into(),
            unstable_mesh: true,
            device_label: "mesh-on".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("deploy");
    let _local = ensure_local_device(&pool, "mesh-on").await.unwrap();

    let report = SyncEngine::run_mesh_sync(&pool).await.expect("mesh");
    assert!(report.attempted >= 1);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn run_replica_sync_push_and_pull_success() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let server = MockServer::start().await;
    deploy(
        &pool,
        &SyncDeploymentConfig {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
            role: DeviceRole::Replica,
            master_base_url: server.uri(),
            master_access_token: "full-sync".into(),
            master_device_id: "master-device".into(),
            device_label: "replica-full".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("deploy");
    let device = ensure_local_device(&pool, "replica-full").await.unwrap();
    append_outbox(
        &pool,
        &device,
        "app_kv",
        "full.key",
        "INSERT",
        r#"{"key":"full.key","value":"sent"}"#,
    )
    .await
    .expect("outbox");

    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/push"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "accepted": 1,
            "lastSeq": 1
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    let remote_entry = serde_json::json!({
        "id": "full-pull",
        "deviceId": "master-device",
        "seq": 1,
        "entityTable": "app_kv",
        "entityId": "pulled.key",
        "op": "INSERT",
        "payloadJson": r#"{"key":"pulled.key","value":"down"}"#,
        "createdAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    });
    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/pull"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "entries": [remote_entry]
        })))
        .mount(&server)
        .await;

    let report = SyncEngine::run_replica_sync(&pool).await.expect("sync");
    assert!(report.error.is_none(), "{:?}", report.error);
    assert_eq!(report.push.as_ref().map(|p| p.accepted), Some(1));
    assert_eq!(report.pull.as_ref().map(|p| p.applied), Some(1));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn run_mesh_sync_pushes_pending_outbox_to_peer() {
    let pool = fresh_pool().await;
    let master_server = MockServer::start().await;
    let peer_server = MockServer::start().await;
    let sk = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[9u8; 32]);
    let pubkey = master_keys::pubkey_b64(&sk);
    let master_id = "master-mesh-push";

    let peers_json = serde_json::json!([{
        "deviceId": "peer-target",
        "slaveLabel": "Peer Target",
        "slavePubkey": "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=",
        "peerBaseUrl": format!("{}/", peer_server.uri())
    }]);
    let canonical = serde_json::json!({
        "masterDeviceId": master_id,
        "peers": peers_json
    });
    let signature = master_keys::sign(&sk, &serde_json::to_vec(&canonical).unwrap());

    Mock::given(method("GET"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/pairing/peers"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "masterDeviceId": master_id,
            "peers": peers_json,
            "signature": signature
        })))
        .mount(&master_server)
        .await;

    Mock::given(method("POST"))
        .and(path("/api/v1/sync/push"))
        .respond_with(ResponseTemplate::new(200).set_body_json(serde_json::json!({
            "accepted": 1,
            "lastSeq": 1
        })))
        .mount(&peer_server)
        .await;

    deploy(
        &pool,
        &SyncDeploymentConfig {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: DeploymentMode::ServerlessPeer,
            role: DeviceRole::Replica,
            master_base_url: master_server.uri(),
            master_access_token: "mesh-push-tok".into(),
            master_pubkey: pubkey,
            master_device_id: master_id.into(),
            unstable_mesh: true,
            device_label: "mesh-pusher".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("deploy");
    let local = ensure_local_device(&pool, "mesh-pusher").await.unwrap();
    append_outbox(
        &pool,
        &local,
        "app_kv",
        "mesh.peer.key",
        "INSERT",
        r#"{"key":"mesh.peer.key","value":"peer-bound"}"#,
    )
    .await
    .expect("outbox");
    seed_peer_tls_pin(&pool, "peer-target").await;

    let report = SyncEngine::run_mesh_sync(&pool).await.expect("mesh");
    assert_eq!(report.attempted, 1);
    assert_eq!(report.succeeded, 1);
    assert!(peer_server
        .received_requests()
        .await
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|r| !r.is_empty()));
}
